title: Wealth Manager
description:
**Locations:** 
 Mumbai
 



**Experience:** 
 3–5 years
 



**Industry:** 
 Wealth Management
 



**Company:** 
 Stockify Fintech
 



**Package:** 

 Fixed CTC: Rs. 5\.0 Lakhs per annum \+ Yearly bonus (3\-6 months salary)
 








**About Stockify** 




  






 Stockify is building India's most trusted marketplace for pre\-IPO and unlisted shares, giving HNI and UHNI investors access to exclusive investment opportunities before companies go public. We cover a wide universe of high\-growth unlisted companies across sectors and provide investors with pricing, research and seamless transaction support. Our offices are in Bengaluru, Mumbai, Gurugram and Dubai, and we are expanding our wealth management team aggressively to serve the growing demand from sophisticated investors.
 




  





**About the Role** 




  






 We are hiring experienced Wealth Managers for our Mumbai office. This is a senior client\-facing role where you will manage a portfolio of HNI and UHNI investors, advise them on pre\-IPO and unlisted share investment opportunities, and drive AUM and revenue growth for Stockify. The role combines relationship management, investment advisory and business development in equal measure.
 




  






 This is the right role for a wealth professional who already understands how HNI clients think, has experience with alternative investments or capital markets products, and wants to work in one of the most exciting and high\-growth segments of Indian finance. You will have the full backing of Stockify's research, operations and technology teams, but the relationships you build and the revenue you generate will be very much your own.
 




  





**What You Will Do** 




  




* Build, manage and grow a dedicated book of HNI and UHNI clients who are interested in pre\-IPO and unlisted share investments, with a focus on deepening relationships and increasing AUM over time
* Advise clients on specific unlisted share opportunities available on the Stockify platform, clearly explaining pricing, liquidity considerations, transfer timelines, risk factors and potential upside in a way that is suitable to their financial profile
* Proactively source new HNI leads through your personal network, referrals from existing clients, community events, industry associations and targeted outreach to high\-net\-worth individuals across Mumbai \& west India
* Conduct client meetings, portfolio reviews and investment update calls at regular intervals, keeping clients informed on the performance of their holdings and new opportunities that match their profile
* Cross\-sell Stockify's broader investment offering to existing clients and introduce referrals to the B2B sales team where appropriate
* Work closely with the back office team to ensure smooth and timely execution of all client transactions, including documentation, share transfer and settlement
* Maintain detailed and up\-to\-date records of all client interactions, portfolios, upcoming transactions and follow\-ups in the CRM on a daily basis
* Represent Stockify professionally at investor events, wealth management conferences and community gatherings to build brand visibility and source new relationships



  





**What We Are Looking For** 




  




* Three to six years of experience in wealth management, private banking, investment advisory or relationship management within a financial services organisation
* A strong and demonstrable existing network of HNI clients in Mumbai and west India who trust your investment recommendations and are open to alternative investments
* Prior experience advising clients on alternative investment products such as PMS, AIF, unlisted shares, pre\-IPO investments, structured products or private equity is strongly preferred
* NISM certification in Mutual Funds Distribution or Investment Advisory is preferred; candidates without certification but with a strong track record will also be considered
* Excellent consultative selling skills, with the ability to explain complex investment ideas in a simple and compelling way without oversimplifying the risks involved
* High integrity, a client\-first approach and the professional maturity to build lasting relationships based on trust rather than transactional interactions
* Self\-motivated with the discipline to independently manage a pipeline, set your own outreach schedule and consistently deliver against revenue targets



  





**Compensation and Benefits** 




  




* Fixed CTC: Rs. 5\.0 Lakhs per annum \+ Yearly bonus
* Performance Incentives: Bonus of up to 3 to 6 months of monthly salary, paid based on individual and company performance
* Review Cycle: Performance review at 6 months with potential for salary revision, with earning potential that grows significantly with AUM and revenue performance

description:

1. Fintech Association for Consumer Empowerment (FACE) is a non\-profit industry association and RBI\-recognised Self\-Regulatory Organisation in the FinTech sector (SRO\-FT). FinTech companies come together at FACE to facilitate consumer\-centric digital financial services that are safe, suitable, and transparent, delivering positive impacts on society and the economy. Please visit our website and refer to the SRO\-FT Framework to understand our work.
2. As an industry association and SRO\-FT, FACE works with the FinTech ecosystem towards innovative, sustainable, and responsible conduct in the FinTech sector, delivering consumer progress and well\-being in line with public policy objectives. The work requires working with a) the supply side, i.e. industry, to improve their employees’ capacity and awareness of conduct and compliance and b) the demand side, i.e. consumers, to improve their understanding of risks, rewards, rights and responsibilities with respect to digital financial services.

title: Salesforce Architect – Service 2.0
description:
#### **Job Description**


Job Description
  

Salesforce Architect – Service 2\.0
  

About Service 2\.0
  

Service 2\.0 is Blue Star's three\-year transformation of the Unitary Products service business, moving from reactive complaint handling to proactive ownership of the customer experience.
  

The programme is redesigning the complete customer journey — from installation and warranty onboarding through breakdown, repair, closure and renewal — on a modern service technology stack comprising Salesforce as the system of record, Salesforce Field Service (FSL) for the technician workforce, a bi\-directional integration backbone with SAP and partner systems, and a WhatsApp\-first customer communication layer.
  

The transformation includes GenAI\-powered service bots and self\-service, intelligent ticket allocation, workforce capacity optimisation, mobile\-first field workflows, digital proof\-of\-work, AI\-assisted audit, predictive analytics and role\-based performance dashboards.
  

The programme operates across a pan\-India service ecosystem of partners and technicians and is measured through business outcomes including warranty cost, first\-time\-fix rate, turnaround time and customer satisfaction.
  

Role: Salesforce Architect – Service 2\.0
  

We are looking for an experienced Salesforce Architect to own the technology architecture and solution design for the Service 2\.0 transformation.
  

The person will be responsible for translating business and service transformation objectives into a scalable Salesforce architecture covering Salesforce Service Cloud, Salesforce Field Service, integrations, digital channels, automation, analytics and AI/GenAI capabilities.
  

The role will work closely with business leaders, service operations, IT teams, Salesforce/product teams, integration teams, partners and implementation vendors to establish a robust architecture that can scale across Blue Star's pan\-India service network.
  

Key Responsibilities
  

1\. Salesforce Architecture \& Solution Design
  

* Own the end\-to\-end Salesforce architecture for Service 2\.0\.
* Define the target architecture across Salesforce Service Cloud, Salesforce Field Service, Experience Cloud/digital channels and supporting Salesforce capabilities.
* Translate business requirements and service\-process designs into scalable, secure and maintainable Salesforce solutions.
* Define application, data, integration and security architecture.
* Establish architecture principles, design standards and reusable patterns.
* Evaluate new Salesforce capabilities and recommend their adoption where they create measurable business value.
* Ensure the architecture remains scalable for future service transformation initiatives.

2\. Field Service \& Technician Transformation
  

* Architect Salesforce Field Service solutions supporting the complete technician lifecycle.
* Design solutions for work\-order management, intelligent scheduling, dispatch, technician allocation, capacity planning, mobility and digital proof\-of\-work.
* Enable optimisation of technician productivity, travel, skill matching, SLA adherence and first\-time\-fix.
* Design mobile\-first experiences suitable for a large and diverse pan\-India technician ecosystem.
* Ensure solutions work effectively across service partners and different operating models.

3\. Customer Service \& Digital Experience
  

* Architect end\-to\-end customer journeys across complaint registration, service request, appointment, technician visit, repair, closure and renewal.
* Design WhatsApp\-first and digital self\-service journeys integrated with Salesforce.
* Define architecture for GenAI\-powered service bots and assisted customer\-service journeys.
* Enable consistent customer interactions across digital and assisted service channels.
* Ensure customer, asset, warranty and service history are available as a unified view.

4\. Integration Architecture
  

* Own the Salesforce integration architecture with SAP, partner systems, WhatsApp and other enterprise applications.
* Define API, event\-driven and bi\-directional integration patterns.
* Ensure reliable synchronisation of customer, product, asset, warranty, service and transaction data.
* Establish standards for integration security, monitoring, error handling, retry mechanisms and performance.
* Work with integration architects and technology teams to build a scalable integration backbone.

5\. AI, GenAI \& Intelligent Service
  

* Define the architecture for AI/GenAI use cases within the service ecosystem.
* Identify opportunities to use AI for customer self\-service, case classification and summarisation, technician assistance, smart ticket allocation, capacity and demand forecasting, audit and anomaly detection, and predictive service analytics.
* Ensure AI solutions are integrated appropriately into Salesforce workflows and user experiences.
* Establish governance around data, security, accuracy and responsible AI adoption.

6\. Data, Analytics \& Performance Management
  

* Define the Salesforce data architecture supporting service analytics and reporting.
* Ensure data quality, consistency and availability across the service ecosystem.
* Enable role\-based dashboards for service leaders, managers, partners and field teams.
* Work with data and analytics teams to enable predictive service insights.
* Establish architecture that supports measurement of warranty cost, first\-time\-fix, turnaround time, technician productivity and customer satisfaction.

7\. Governance \& Technical Leadership
  

* Act as the technical authority for Salesforce architecture within Service 2\.0\.
* Review and approve solution designs, technical specifications and major changes.
* Establish Salesforce development, configuration, integration and release\-management standards.
* Drive technical debt reduction and platform optimisation.
* Ensure appropriate Salesforce licensing and platform utilisation.
* Conduct architecture reviews and ensure adherence to enterprise architecture and security standards.
* Mentor Salesforce developers, administrators and implementation partners.

8\. Partner \& Programme Management
  

* Work closely with Salesforce, system integrators and technology partners.
* Provide technical direction to implementation partners and ensure adherence to the target architecture.
* Challenge solution designs where required and ensure commercial and technical decisions are aligned.
* Support programme planning, estimation, prioritisation and technology\-roadmap decisions.
* Ensure successful transition from implementation to sustainable operations and support.

Key Deliverables / Success Measures
  

The Salesforce Architect will be expected to deliver:
  

* Robust target\-state Salesforce architecture for Service 2\.0\.
* Scalable Salesforce Service Cloud and Field Service architecture across the pan\-India service network.
* Seamless integration between Salesforce, SAP, partners and digital channels.
* Mobile\-first and technician\-centric service workflows.
* Intelligent allocation, scheduling and capacity\-management capabilities.
* WhatsApp\-first customer engagement and self\-service journeys.
* AI/GenAI\-enabled service capabilities with measurable business value.
* Reliable service data and performance dashboards.
* Strong platform governance, security, scalability and maintainability.
* Reduction in technical debt and unnecessary customisation.
* Architecture aligned to measurable improvements in warranty cost, first\-time\-fix rate, service turnaround time, technician productivity and customer satisfaction.

Candidate Profile
  

Education
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline.
* Relevant Salesforce certifications are strongly preferred.

Experience
  

* 10–15\+ years of overall technology experience, with significant experience in Salesforce architecture and enterprise application transformation.
* Strong hands\-on architecture experience across Salesforce Service Cloud and Salesforce Field Service.
* Experience designing large\-scale Salesforce implementations involving complex integrations and multiple stakeholder groups.
* Experience in field service, after\-sales service, customer service or service transformation is highly desirable.
* Experience working with large distributed field/service networks is an advantage.
* Experience in enterprise\-scale digital transformation programmes involving multiple technology platforms.

Salesforce Expertise
  

Strong understanding of:
  

* Salesforce Service Cloud
* Salesforce Field Service
* Service Console
* Case Management
* Work Orders and Service Appointments
* Scheduling and optimisation
* Omni\-Channel
* Salesforce APIs and integration patterns
* Platform Events / event\-driven architecture
* Apex and Lightning architecture
* Data modelling and security architecture
* Salesforce Flow and automation
* Experience Cloud / digital experience
* Salesforce reporting and analytics
* Salesforce AI/GenAI capabilities

Integration \& Technology Skills
  

* Strong understanding of enterprise integration architecture.
* Experience with REST/SOAP APIs, middleware and event\-driven architectures.
* Experience or understanding of SAP integration and enterprise master\-data concepts.
* Knowledge of cloud architecture, API security and identity/access management.
* Understanding of data platforms, analytics and AI/ML architectures.
* Ability to assess build\-vs\-buy and standard\-vs\-customisation decisions.

Leadership \& Behavioural Competencies
  

The candidate should demonstrate:
  

* Strong enterprise architecture thinking with the ability to connect technology decisions to business outcomes.
* Excellent understanding of customer\-service and field\-service processes.
* Ability to simplify complex technology landscapes.
* Strong stakeholder\-management and communication skills.
* Ability to influence business and technology leaders without relying solely on hierarchical authority.
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making capabilities.
* Commercial orientation and ability to evaluate technology investments based on ROI.
* Ability to work effectively with internal teams, vendors and implementation partners.
* Strong ownership and accountability for architecture decisions and outcomes.
* Curiosity and willingness to continuously evaluate emerging Salesforce, AI and digital technologies.

Preferred Certifications
  

* Salesforce Certified Application Architect
* Salesforce Certified System Architect
* Salesforce Certified Technical Architect (CTA) – highly desirable
* Salesforce Certified Service Cloud Consultant
* Salesforce Certified Field Service Consultant
* Salesforce Platform Developer certifications
* Relevant integration/cloud architecture certifications

description:
Chat Operations Manager is responsible for leading and optimizing the performance of customer service team focused on chat interactions. This role drives the achievement of key digital customer service indicators (KPIs), ensures efficient handling of chat volumes, and maintains a consistently high\-quality customer experience across all chat channels. The manager will lead, develop, and mentor their agents, implement strategic initiatives for chat operations, and foster a culture of digital excellence and continuous improvement.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Operational Leadership: Oversee the daily operations of customer service team, ensuring optimal staffing, efficient chat queue management, and adherence to digital communication policies and procedures.
* Performance Management: Establish, monitor, and achieve critical chat\-specific customer service KPIs, including Average Response Time (ART), Concurrent Chat Handling, Chat Abandonment Rate, Quality Assurance (QA) scores for written interactions, and First Contact Resolution (FCR) in digital channels. Develop and implement strategies to enhance these metrics.
* Team Development \& Coaching: Lead, coach, and mentor team members focusing on effective written communication, tone, multi\-tasking skills in a chat environment, and efficient use of chat tools and resources. Conduct regular performance reviews and identify development opportunities.
* Strategy \& Planning: Contribute to the strategic development and execution of digital customer service initiatives, including integrating new chat technologies, optimizing chat flows, and exploring AI/chatbot synergies to improve efficiency and customer experience.
* Process Improvement: Identify areas for improvement within chat operations, implement best practices for digital engagement, streamline chat processes (e.g., template usage, knowledge base integration), and reduce resolution times. Drive continuous improvement based on data analysis and customer feedback.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Collaborate with cross\-functional teams such as Workforce Management, Technology, Bot team and Quality Assurance to ensure seamless integration of chat channels and alignment with overall business goals.
* Reporting \& Analysis: Analyze chat interaction data, generate comprehensive reports on team performance, chat trends, and bot performance. Provide actionable insights and recommendations to senior management for strategic decision\-making.
* Issue Resolution: Serve as an escalation point for complex or sensitive customer issues encountered via chat, ensuring timely and effective resolution while upholding service standards.
* Compliance \& Risk Management: Ensure all chat operations comply with internal policies, industry regulations, and legal requirements pertaining to digital communication and data privacy. Identify and mitigate potential operational risks
* Projects \& Initiatives: Lead and participate in various projects and initiatives aimed at enhancing the chat platform, introducing new features, improving agent tools, or integrating with other digital channels to elevate the overall digital customer experience.


**Qualifications:**
* Education: Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience. Master's degree preferred.
* Experience: Minimum of 10\+ years of progressive experience in customer service operations, with at least 6\+ years in a leadership role managing customer service team (people manager)
* Adaptability: Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, technology\-driven environment and manage multiple digital priorities effectively.
* Leadership Skills: Strong leadership, motivational, and coaching abilities, with a track record of developing high\-performing teams in a digital context.
* Analytical Skills: Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to interpret digital interaction data, identify trends, and make data\-driven decisions.
* Communication: Exceptional written communication skills, with a keen understanding of digital communication etiquette, brand voice, and clarity. Strong verbal communication for internal leadership.
* Technical Proficiency: Proficient in chat management systems, knowledge base systems, and familiarity with AI/chatbot technologies. Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite.


**Desired Attributes:**
* Strategic thinker with an ability to anticipate future trends in digital customer service.
* Proactive and results\-oriented with a strong sense of ownership over digital channels.
* Ability to inspire and influence others towards achieving digital excellence.
* High level of integrity and professionalism.

description:

Everywhere industry meets environment, Clean Harbors is on\-site, providing premier environmental, energy and industrial services. Clean Harbors employs a dedicated workforce of 18,000 employees and has over 450 service locations across the U.S., Canada and Mexico. Beyond addressing the environmental needs of its more than 300,000 customers, the Company has been on the front lines of addressing some of the largest emergency response events in North America of the past several decades including the BP Oil Spill in the Gulf of Mexico, the anthrax attacks in New York, the 2015 avian flu outbreak that devastated the poultry industry, Hurricanes Katrina, Rita and Sandy, and the oil pipeline breaks that affected the Yellowstone and Kalamazoo rivers, along with other major chemical releases into the environment.
  
  

Clean Harbors India has been strategically established as the Global Capability Center (GCC) to serve our parent company. We take pride in serving some of the most tech savvy business stakeholders at Clean Harbors. The GCC employees form part of our globally integrated teams that provide cutting\-edge IT solutions and production support across platforms. Our shared services teams work seamlessly with their global counterparts in providing critical 24x7 support in various functions including Finance, HR, Procurement, IT and Operations. Our aggressive growth plans open significant career advancement opportunities for our employees.

The prime responsibility of this position is to manage inbound calls from our existing customers and assist in an efficient, courteous, professional manner. The key role involves providing customer support via phone, email/chat \- processing payments, scheduling services, handling general queries and cross sell our products across North A

➢ Being the first point of contact for customers and handling all customer inquiries and focusing on First Call Resolution.

➢ The team will be responsible for managing adherence and hygiene while handling these calls.
  
  

➢ Apply active listening skills to diffuse a potential escalation or if required follow through with the right channel for escalation.

➢ Overall, 2\+ years of experience with strong handling of B2B \& B2C Inbound Sales.
  
  

➢ Excellent communication and stakeholder management with an ability to be both persuasive and influential.
  
  

➢ Proficient in English communication skills (Neutral). Should have great relationship building skills and customer orientation to understand customer needs and provide tailored solutions.
  
  

➢ Tremendous work ethic, high integrity, willingness to learn, laser\-focused, passionate \& committed.

**WHO YOU ARE** 
  

 • You have at least 5 years of leadership experience in a customer\-focused, fast paced, and multi\-channel retail environment.
   

 • You are passionate about creating exceptional customer experiences and driving business growth through operational excellence.

 • You have a good understanding of legal compliance, third\-party contracts, safety and security requirements, and can work confidently with external authorities when required.

**YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES** 
  

 • Lead the Customer Experience function by creating a seamless, convenient, and rewarding shopping journey across all customer touchpoints.

 • Ensure operational excellence by identifying and removing barriers that impact customers throughout their buying, checkout, payment, and after\-sales journey.
   

 • Support commercial priorities and collaborate with cross\-functional teams to maximize sales, customer satisfaction, and business performance.
   

 • Oversee the IKEA Food business, ensuring commercial success while maintaining the highest standards of food safety, Swedishness, and regulatory compliance.
   

 • Develop and implement customer service, food business, and operational action plans aligned with local, national, and global business objectives.
   

 • Ensure compliance with IKEA policies, legal requirements, food safety regulations, and operational best practices.
   

 • Build strong partnerships with internal stakeholders and external partners to enhance operational efficiency and protect the IKEA culture and values.
   

 • Plan and manage departmental resources, budgets, and investments to achieve operational and financial targets.

 • Analyze customer, consumer, brand, and operational data to provide recommendations that improve customer experience and business performance.
   

 • Champion continuous improvement initiatives and contribute to the implementation of customer experience and retail food strategies across the store.
   

 • Ensure a safe environment for customers and co\-workers by promoting safety, security, and compliance across all operations.
   

 • Foster collaboration across commercial and support functions to deliver integrated and consistent customer experience across all channels.
   

  

**TOGETHER AS A TEAM** 
  

 At IKEA it’s all about our customers, and in Customer Relations we build and retain long\-lasting relationships with new and existing customers in a multichannel retail environment. title: Customer Success Manager
description:
**Job Description – Customer Success Manager (CSM)**
**Company:** 
 Aliste Technology
   

  

**Department:** 
 Customer Success
   

  

**Designation:** 
 Customer Success Manager
   

  

**Experience:** 
 2–5 years
   

  

**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
   

  

**Location:** 
 Delhi NCR / Noida
   

  

**Reports To:** 
 Head of Customer Success / Head of Support
   

  

**About Aliste Technology**
 Aliste Technology is a smart\-metering and energy\-technology company helping property owners and operators manage electricity consumption, metering, billing and collections more efficiently.
   

  

 We are looking for a
 **high\-ownership Customer Success Manager** 
 who can manage assigned clients/properties end\-to\-end and ensure that customers receive consistent service, operational issues are resolved quickly, and properties remain healthy and retained.
   

  

**Role Objective**
 The CSM will be the
 **primary owner of assigned client accounts/properties** 
 after onboarding.
   

  

**The Person Will Be Responsible For**
* Maintaining strong client relationships.
* Ensuring smooth onboarding and installation.
* Monitoring property health and meter performance.
* Driving resolution of grievances and escalations.
* Coordinating with Operations, CCE, Sales and Finance.
* Monitoring outstanding payments and supporting collections.
* Reducing property churn/drop.
* Driving Auto\-Pay and Partner App adoption.
* Conducting regular client reviews.
* Identifying risks before they become escalations.
* Maintaining accurate CRM/Zoho and reporting data.


 The CSM is expected to
 **own the problem until closure** 
 , rather than simply forwarding it to another team.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Client \& Account Management
* Act as the primary point of contact for assigned clients.
* Build strong professional relationships with property owners, operators and key stakeholders.
* Understand each property's business requirements and operational challenges.
* Conduct regular client calls and meetings.
* Maintain proper records of all important client discussions.
* Ensure commitments made to clients are tracked and closed within agreed timelines.
* Property Health Management


 The CSM should continuously monitor the health of assigned properties, including:
   

  

* Number of active meters.
* Offline meters.
* Installation pendency.
* Replacement pendency.
* Grievances and unresolved tickets.
* Over\-consumption complaints.
* Billing\-related issues.
* Low\-voltage and technical complaints.
* User/deduction\-related issues.
* Outstanding payments.
* Client dissatisfaction/escalation.
* Property drop/churn risk.


 The objective should be
 **zero surprise escalations** 
 —the CSM should identify risks before the client raises them.
   

  

* Grievance \& Escalation Management
* Monitor all open grievances on a daily basis.
* Ensure tickets are progressing within defined TAT/SLA.
* Coordinate with Operations and CCE teams for resolution.
* Follow up with technicians where required.
* Ensure "Under Review" cases are actively followed up and not left unattended.
* Personally handle critical client escalations.
* Keep clients updated until final resolution.
* Ensure closure is properly documented in Zoho.
* Installation \& Operational Coordination
* Coordinate with Operations for new installations.
* Track installation pendency and ageing.
* Ensure technicians complete assigned work properly.
* Ensure final checking/closure processes are followed.
* Coordinate re\-visits wherever genuinely required.
* Ensure client communication happens during important operational activities.
* Identify recurring operational issues and escalate them to management.
* Customer Retention


 The CSM will be directly responsible for reducing customer churn.
   

  

**Responsibilities Include**
* Identify properties showing dissatisfaction or drop risk.
* Maintain a Property Risk/Health Tracker.
* Understand reasons behind client dissatisfaction.
* Create action plans for high\-risk properties.
* Escalate commercial/operational risks to management early.
* Conduct regular client health reviews.
* Maintain strong engagement with decision\-makers.


 Retention is a core CSM responsibility, with customer health and churn risk being standard measures in modern customer\-success teams.
   

  

* Outstanding \& Revenue Coordination
* Monitor outstanding amounts for assigned properties.

title: Area Manager
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE: 
 We are looking for an enthusiastic Area Manager with strong management and operational skills to oversee existing and upcoming restaurants. The ideal candidate should have experience in the QSR or FMCG industry and be responsible for driving sales, profitability, operational excellence, and team performance while ensuring California Burrito standards and customer expectations are consistently met. 
 Locations: Bengaluru | NCR | Pune | Mumbai | Chennai 
 THE IDEAL CANDIDATE: 
 Area Manager is responsible for the overall Business operations of the allocated restaurants according to California Burrito operational standards and run profitable business. A majority of time is spent leading/Guiding and coaching the team to meet Guest expectations, achieving both bottom and topline objectives by the guiding ambition of our organization. 
 Looking for someone who is from QSR or FMCG industry. 
 ROLES/RESPONSIBILITIES: 
 1) LEAD GREAT RESTAURANTS 
 Own the performance of your allotted restaurants and Strive for Excellence across operations, hospitality, food safety, sanitation and cleanliness. Lead from the front. Model great hospitality, coach restaurant teams and remove anything getting in the way of a great guest experience. Empower teams to resolve guest concerns quickly, thoughtfully and for the long term. Spot problems and opportunities early, build clear action plans and make sure they get done. 
 2) BUILD TEAMS THAT KEEP GROWING 
 Build an Open & Honest culture where every team member is treated fairly and respectfully. Develop restaurant leaders and their teams through strong training, regular coaching, meaningful recognition and clear accountability. Set clear goals, share performance openly and give teams Freedom with Ownership to deliver results. Stay flexible and step in wherever the business needs you most. 
 3) DRIVE HEALTHY GROWTH 
 Own sales, costs and profitability across your restaurants, monitoring every cost line against the annual business plan. Regularly review performance with your direct reports, conduct gap analysis and help every restaurant stay on target and achieve its bottom-line incentive. Understand and execute all in-store marketing promotions, while sharing relevant market-level inputs for national marketing across digital, print and other channels. Lead new product rollouts, support new restaurant openings and drive strong sales across new and existing locations. 
 4) KEEP EVERYONE MOVING TOGETHER 
 Work closely with support teams to solve problems, align on business priorities and turn plans into action. Communicate goals, results and next steps clearly so every team understands what they are working towards and how they contribute. Keep growing everyday. Ask for feedback, share ideas and keep finding better ways to work. 
 MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS 
 5+ years of experience in QSR Graduate in any discipline; Hospitality/Hotel Management preferred. Relevant experience in Cafes, QSR, Restaurant or Hospitality Prior experience managing multiple outlets/stores is preferred. Strong leadership, communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Strong understanding of sales, P&L, people management, inventory, and operations. Highly customer-focused, energetic, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment. 
 SALARY 
 Will depend on experience. Upto 10 LPA (including incentives). Local conveyance will be covered by company.

title: Onboarding & Customer Success Executive – EdTech
description:
We are looking for an Onboarding \& Customer Success Executive who will act as the primary point of contact between our organization and schools / educational institutions during the onboarding and implementation process.

The role will be responsible for ensuring that every new institution is onboarded smoothly from account and user ID creation, curriculum and platform setup, data coordination and training to resolving initial queries and ensuring customer satisfaction.

The ideal candidate should be organized, technically comfortable, good at communication and highly customer\-focused. This role is suitable for both fresh graduates with a technical background and candidates with 1–2 years of experience in EdTech, customer success, implementation, project coordination or a similar role.

Key Responsibilities

* Act as the primary Point of Contact (POC) for schools and educational institutions during onboarding and implementation.
* Coordinate the complete onboarding process from initial handover by the Sales team to successful activation and implementation.
* Collect and validate required information from schools, including student, teacher, class, section and other relevant data.
* Coordinate the creation and activation of student, teacher, administrator and institutional IDs/accounts.
* Coordinate with internal Product, Technology, Curriculum and Operations teams to ensure the institution is configured correctly.
* Support the setup and deployment of curriculum, courses, learning content, modules and other educational resources.
* Coordinate platform configuration and ensure that the school's requirements are correctly implemented.
* Conduct or coordinate onboarding sessions, product walkthroughs and basic training for teachers, coordinators and school administrators.
* Handle day\-to\-day customer queries during the onboarding and initial implementation phase.
* Understand customer issues, coordinate internally for resolution and ensure timely closure.
* Maintain regular communication with institutional stakeholders and keep them updated on onboarding progress.
* Track onboarding activities, pending requirements, dependencies and completion timelines.
* Maintain accurate onboarding records, checklists, reports and documentation.
* Monitor the initial customer experience and proactively identify issues that may affect adoption or satisfaction.
* Collect customer feedback and communicate recurring requirements or concerns to the relevant internal teams.
* Coordinate with the Sales team during the transition from sales closure to implementation and customer success.
* Ensure that customers receive a smooth and professional experience throughout the onboarding journey.
* Support customer retention and adoption by maintaining strong relationships with institutional stakeholders.

Technical Responsibilities

The candidate does not need to be an advanced programmer, but should be comfortable working with technology and learning new systems.

The role may involve:

* Basic understanding of coding/programming concepts.
* Working with web\-based platforms and educational technology products.
* Basic understanding of databases, spreadsheets and data management.
* Handling user/account creation and platform configuration.
* Basic troubleshooting and issue identification.
* Working with Excel / Google Sheets and other productivity tools.
* Understanding basic concepts of HTML, Python, JavaScript or other programming languages will be an advantage.
* Coordinating with technical teams and communicating customer requirements/issues clearly.

Required Skills

* Excellent communication and customer\-handling skills.
* Strong coordination and follow\-up abilities.
* Good organizational and project\-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple schools/institutions and onboarding activities simultaneously.
* Strong attention to detail, especially when handling student/teacher data and account setup.
* Comfortable working with technology and learning new software/platforms quickly.
* Good problem\-solving and troubleshooting ability.
* Proficiency in MS Excel / Google Sheets / PowerPoint.
* Ability to communicate professionally with teachers, coordinators, principals and other institutional stakeholders.
* Willingness to take ownership of customer issues until resolution.

Educational Qualification

Preferred:

* B.Tech / B.E. – CSE, IT, AI/ML, Data Science, ECE or related technical disciplines.
* BCA / MCA or other relevant technical qualifications.
* Candidates from other disciplines with strong EdTech/customer\-facing experience may also be considered.

For Freshers

Freshers with a technical background are welcome to apply if they demonstrate:

* Basic programming/coding knowledge.
* Strong communication skills.
* Good logical and problem\-solving ability.
* Interest in EdTech and technology.
* Strong ownership and willingness to learn.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who can take ownership of the entire customer onboarding journey and ensure that schools do not feel lost after signing up with us.

You should be someone who follows up proactively, keeps track of multiple moving parts, communicates clearly with customers and internal teams, and does not wait for someone else to solve a problem.

The role requires a combination of technology awareness, project coordination, customer service and problem\-solving.

Pay: ₹400,000\.00 \- ₹500,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

* Experience with ERP platforms such as SAP, Salesforce, Odoo or similar is a strong advantage.
* Background in technical implementation, SaaS onboarding or BA roles is highly preferred.
* Working experience in Distribution, Supply Chain or B2B Commerce industries is a plus.
* Bachelor's degree mandatory — negotiable for candidates with strong relevant experience.
* Technical Skills
* Familiarity with Postman, REST APIs and integration workflows.
* Experience with QA processes, UAT and product testing.
* Proficiency in CRM tools — Salesforce, Odoo, HubSpot or similar.
* Basic understanding of ERP workflows — SAP, Tally, Zoho or similar.
* Ability to read and interpret API documentation and integration specs.

* Commercial Instinct — you don't just support clients, you spot expansion opportunities and drive upsells naturally.
* Stakeholder Management — you can hold a room, manage pushback and get buy\-in from skeptical decision\-makers.
* Ownership Mindset — you drive tasks to completion without being told and think proactively about what comes next.
* Communication — excellent verbal and written communication with clients, leadership and internal teams.
* Adaptability — ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, high\-growth startup environment.


**What Matters More Than The Resume**
* Stakeholder Management \& Persuasion: You can hold a room and manage pushback from insecure internal influencers who fear automation.
* Technical — Postman, REST APIs, QA/UAT, CRM tools (Salesforce, Odoo), ERP background (SAP, Tally, Zoho) — advantage.
* Domain — Supply chain, distribution, B2B commerce or SaaS implementation background — strongly preferred.
* Mindset — Commercial instinct, ownership, stakeholder management and hunger to make clients genuinely successful.
* Commercial Instinct: You don't just support clients; you spot expansion opportunities and naturally drive upsells post\-onboarding.
* Industry \& SaaS Context: Deep familiarity with supply chain, distribution, or B2B SaaS workflows to guide clients.


**Why Join ZoTok?**
 At ZoTok, you won't be managing accounts — you will be shaping how India's businesses operate on WhatsApp. You'll work at the intersection of AI, commerce and technology, building something that has never been done before in India.
   

  

* Be part of India's first Network CRM for conversational commerce — a category\-defining product.
* Work directly with Brands, Distributors and Retailers across India's $1 trillion\+ General Trade ecosystem.
* Deep domain expertise in Supply Chain Management and B2B SaaS — skills that compound over time.
* Fast\-paced, ownership\-driven culture where your impact is visible and rewarded.
* Opportunity to grow into senior leadership as we scale rapidly across India and globally.


*ZoTok occupies a niche market with tremendous demand. Join us and be part of something truly extraordinary — redefining Conversational Commerce in India and beyond.*

title: Enterprise Account Manager
description:
**ABOUT CULTUREMONKEY** 





 CultureMonkey is an AI\-powered employee engagement and experience platform that helps organizations build exceptional workplaces through continuous listening, people analytics, and action planning. Trusted across 100\+ countries and rated 4\.7/5 on G2, we partner with HR and business leaders \- at companies like Bausch Health, Yahoo, Sony and United Bank.
 




  





**THE ROLE \- OWN KEY ACCOUNTS** 





 Our Customer Success team in Chennai supports customers superbly, day in and day out. What we're building on top of that is the relationship layer: staying ahead of account health, building genuine rapport with the people who matter.
 





 You will own that for our most important accounts. You are their relationship and commercial owner, accountable for their satisfaction, their renewals and the expansion that follows when customers genuinely succeed. CS and product own onboarding, configuration, and day\-to\-day resolution.
 
**You own the relationship and the outcome. Think of yourself as the CEO of these top accounts.** 




  





**WHAT YOU'LL OWN** 



* **Own the relationship.** 

 Real rapport with champions, economic buyers, and executive sponsors across every top account \- the trusted first call, never just the ticket\-closer.
* **Stay ahead of account health.** 

 Keep a live health view on every account, and catch risk through usage, sentiment, and stakeholder signals long before it ever reaches a renewal.
* **Connect goals to value.** 

 Track what each customer set out to achieve, map it against what they've actually gotten, and lead the conversations that close the gap out loud.
* **Own renewals end to end.** 

 Run 90/60/30\-day cadences, keep an honest forecast, lead the commercial conversation and negotiation \- and make renewals feel like a formality, not a scramble.
* **Grow the account.** 

 Spot expansion rooted in real need \- new teams, use cases, modules / new features \- and carry those conversations from opening to close.
* **Make business reviews matter.** 

 Run monthly and quarterly reviews as strategic partnership conversations tied to outcomes, never status updates.
* **Own every escalation.** 

 When something breaks, own the customer's experience of the fix end to end \- pulling in CS, product, and engineering while the relationship stays steady.



  





**WHAT WINNING LOOKS LIKE** 



* **First 30 days \-** 

 Know top accounts inside out. Build account plans, relationship maps, health views, customer goals, and renewal calendars. Start having meaningful customer conversations.
* **3 months \-** 

 Strong relationships across the portfolio. Risks are identified early. Customer goals are actively tracked. Business reviews are strategic, not status updates. Renewals feel predictable.
* **6 months \-** 

 Our top customers are genuinely happy, referenceable, and seeing measurable value. Renewals are healthy, expansion comes from real customer needs.



  





**HOW TO MEASURE** 



* **Customer happiness \-** 

 CSAT / NPS, qualitative sentiment, advocacy, referenceability.
* **Relationship health \-** 

 Multi\-threaded relationships, executive engagement, stakeholder coverage.
* **Customer outcomes \-** 

 Goals achieved, adoption, value realisation, business reviews.
* **Commercial outcomes \-** 

 GRR/NRR, renewal predictability, expansion, accurate account forecasting.



  





**AI\-FIRST, BY DEFAULT** 





 AI should be part of your everyday workflow. Use it for account research, stakeholder mapping, call preparation, meeting summaries, follow\-ups, account plans, risk identification, customer insight synthesis, and finding leverage across your book of business. The more AI is second nature to you, the bigger your edge in this role.
 




  





**YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF…** 



* You genuinely enjoy talking to customers and building relationships, not just managing workflows.
* You remember what matters to people and follow through without being asked.
* You are commercially aware without becoming transactional.
* You can have uncomfortable conversations early and respectfully.
* You are naturally curious about the customer's business and can connect product usage to business outcomes.
* You take ownership when something is broken, even when another team technically owns the task.



  





**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR** 



* **6–10 years** 

 in Account Management, Customer Success, or Enterprise Sales at a B2B company \- carrying commercial ownership, not just support.
* A track record you can name: renewals you protected and expansions you personally closed.
* You've carried satisfaction as a number \- retention, NRR, CSAT, or NPS on your scorecard.
* The presence to talk value, ROI, pricing, and contract structure with senior and C\-suite stakeholders.
* An AI\-first mindset, and comfort with US/EMEA\-hours overlap and travel to key accounts when it counts.



  





**HOW TO APPLY: 1\-MINUTE VIDEO REQUIRED** 





 Along with your application, send us a one\-minute video of yourself.
 
**No video \- auto\-reject.** 




  






 Tell us who you are and why you'd be a great fit at CultureMonkey. It doesn't need to be polished \- raw, unscripted, and just you is exactly what we want. We care about the person, not the production. That's the fastest way to stand out with us.
 



* Record a 1\-minute video \- keep it to 60–75 seconds maximum.
* Attach it to your application email. If it's too large, upload to Google Drive or WeTransfer and share the link, set to
 
*“anyone with the link can view.”*
* **Subject line:** 

 Enterprise Account Manager Application – \[Your Name]
* **Send to:** 
**interviews@culturemonkey.io**



  





***If you want to be the reason our biggest customers stay, grow, and rave about us \- we want to talk to you.***

title: Manager IT Implementation
description:
**About Rippling** 




  





 Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
 



  





 Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.
 



  





 Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.
 



  





 We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.
 



  





**About the role** 




  





 Rippling’s Product Specialist team ensures customers see incredible business transformation through Rippling's most complex products.
 



  





 Our engagements are consultative. Our specialists deeply understand the customers’ unique pain points, offer creative solutions, and build/set up their Rippling environment to address their needs. Hence, our specialists serve as a bridge between the customer and product teams. They are instrumental in driving adoption.
 



  





 As a Manager, IT Implementation, you will lead a team of \~7/8 specialists to drive the exponential impact of adoption and customer lifetime value (LTV) across Rippling’s IT product offerings (Identity and Access Management, Device Management, Inventory Management, and Third\-Party IdP).
 



  





 The ideal candidate has a proven track record of leading client\-facing implementation, professional services, or technical client support teams in a fast\-paced B2B SaaS environment, combined with the technical ability needed to guide specialists through complex customer environments.
 



  





**What you will do** 




  




* Direct a global team of IT Product Specialists, fostering accountability, continuous professional development, and execution excellence.
* Lead the front\-line execution of IT implementations from client kickoff through go\-live, ensuring your team hits key milestones and maximizes product adoption.
* Identify and mitigate risks associated with implementation projects, act as an escalation point for complex client implementations and technical issues
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with Rippling Sales, Technical Account Management, and Support teams to create a seamless customer journey
* Collaborate with Product \& Engineering to continuously improve product functionality based on customer feedback in Implementation
* Monitor key performance metrics and continuous improvement on KPIs while helping to optimize playbooks and frameworks for increased simplicity and efficiency



  





**What you will need** 




  




* 2\+ years of professional experience directly managing teams within a customer\-facing organization, such as Professional Services, Customer Implementation and Technical Client Support.
* Strong foundational knowledge of corporate IT landscapes. You must be comfortable coaching a team that works daily with MDM, identity provisioning (SSO, SAML/OIDC), Zero Touch deployment, and Endpoint Lifecycle Management (e.g., Google Workspace, Azure AD, Okta).
* 5\+ years of overall experience in customer onboarding or software implementation, with a clear understanding of managing external customer relationships and project timelines.
* A track record of developing, tracking, and optimizing operational metrics, team capacity, and project timelines.
* Self\-starter with a bias towards action, energized by ambiguity and a fast\-paced environment, with a strong desire to build.



  





**Note** 



* **This is a hybrid role and will require you to work out of our Bangalore office three days a week.**
* **This job requires you a to work in the EST/PST shift.**



  





**Additional Information** 




  





 Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accomodations@rippling.com
 



 Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

title: Customer Experience Manager
description:
Fresh Platter is looking for a Customer Experience Manager to own the day\-to\-day experience of working with us.
 **Our goal is simple: customers should find Fresh Platter exceptionally easy, responsive and dependable to do business with \- even when the answer is not what they want to hear.** 




  





**Fresh produce is fast\-moving and perishable. Quantities change, prices move, quality issues can arise, vehicles get delayed, POs may be pending, and customer indents can be higher or lower than expected. These realities will not disappear. This role exists to make sure they are managed calmly, proactively and methodically, so the customer always knows what is happening and never has to repeatedly chase Fresh Platter for an answer.** 




  





**This is not a traditional sales\-acquisition role, an accounts role or an operations role.** 
 It is the customer\-facing coordination layer across all of them. You will be the dependable day\-to\-day point of contact for customers while working closely with Sales, Procurement, Operations, Dispatch and Accounts to close every loop from start to finish.
 



  





  





**What you will own**




 ·       
 **Customer communication:** 
 Be the single dependable day\-to\-day point of contact for customer indents, forecasts, rates, availability, POs, dispatches, delivery updates, quality issues, claims and routine commercial matters.
 



 ·       
 **Indents and order flow:** 
 Collect indents on time, clarify changes, follow up for missing information, communicate confirmed quantities internally and ensure the customer receives timely confirmation.
 



 ·       
 **Rates and commercial communication:** 
 Communicate and negotiate rates within approved commercial boundaries, handle difficult rate conversations calmly, obtain customer confirmation and ensure agreed rates are properly recorded.
 



 ·       
 **Availability management:** 
 Communicate shortages, excess availability, substitutions or changes early. Work with the customer and internal teams to find the best practical outcome instead of allowing surprises at the last minute.
 



 ·       
 **Exception handling:** 
 Manage quality complaints, rejections, short supply, oversupply, packing delays, vehicle delays, missed timelines and other issues without panic. Keep the customer informed, coordinate the internal response, propose the next action and drive the matter to closure.
 



 ·       
 **Proactive follow\-through:** 
 Customers should not have to keep calling Fresh Platter for updates. Track every commitment, follow up before deadlines and close open items completely.
 



 ·       
 **Cross\-functional coordination:** 
 Obtain information from Sales, Procurement, Operations, Dispatch and Accounts and communicate one clear, consistent response to the customer. Bring customer requirements back into the company in the same disciplined manner.
 



 ·       
 **Commercial closures:** 
 Coordinate customer\-facing follow\-up on debit notes, credit notes, rate confirmations, claims and other commercial documentation, while Accounts continues to own accounting and financial records.
 



 ·       
 **Customer compliance and administration:** 
 Handle customer\-facing documentation and portal requirements, including sharing updated FSSAI, GST and other relevant company documents, ensuring customer records are updated, completing customer/vendor portals and tracking any compliance\-related requests to closure.
 



 ·       
 **MIS and records:** 
 Maintain accurate customer\-wise MIS covering indents, rates, supply commitments, open issues, claims, documentation, follow\-ups and closures.
 



 ·       
 **Systems and standardization:** 
 Work through defined systems, templates and workflows rather than ad\-hoc messages or information stored in personal memory. Enter the relevant facts, use standardized communication wherever possible, and maintain a complete record of what was communicated, promised and closed.
 



 ·       
 **Process improvement:** 
 Build and continuously improve repeatable processes for recurring situations \- shortages, quality complaints, delayed dispatches, pending POs, rate discussions, excess availability and other customer scenarios \- so the company becomes less dependent on individual firefighting.
 



  





**What we are looking for**




 ·       5\+ years of relevant experience in fresh produce, perishables, food distribution, grocery, modern trade, quick commerce, FMCG supply chains or a closely related environment.
 



 ·       Hands\-on exposure to the realities of a perishable supply chain. You should already understand concepts such as shrinkage, quality rejection, variable availability, short/excess supply, time\-sensitive dispatches and customer service failures \- we are not looking to teach these basics from scratch.
 



 ·       Strong customer\-facing experience. You should be able to walk into the role, understand the problem quickly and say, "I will handle it," rather than becoming uncomfortable when conversations get difficult.
 



 ·       Excellent spoken and written English is mandatory. Emails, WhatsApp messages and formal communication must be clear, polished, professional and unambiguous.
 



 ·       Fluent spoken Kannada is mandatory. You should be completely comfortable and natural engaging Kannada\-speaking customers in Kannada. Additional knowledge of Telugu, Tamil or Hindi is an advantage.
 



 ·       Calm, emotionally steady and thick\-skinned. You should be able to handle disagreement, pressure, complaints and uncomfortable conversations without becoming defensive, flustered or abrasive.
 



 ·       Street\-smart and commercially sensible. You should know when to persuade, when to hold your ground, when to offer an alternative and when to escalate.
 



 ·       Methodical and disciplined. If an item needs to be recorded, followed up, reported or closed, you do it every time \- not only when someone reminds you.
 



 ·       Agile and comfortable multitasking. Several customer issues may move simultaneously and priorities can change quickly.
 



 ·       Comfortable using software, structured workflows, customer portals, MIS tools and standardized communication systems. Process discipline is non\-negotiable.
 



 ·       Flexible with working hours. Fresh produce does not always operate on a strict 9\-to\-6 rhythm, and important customer matters occasionally require attention earlier in the morning or later in the evening.
 



  





**What success looks like**




 ·       Customers experience Fresh Platter as responsive, reliable, and extremely easy to work with.
 



 ·       Customers should never chase us for routine information or updates.
 



 ·       Indents, rates, availability, POs, dispatch information and open issues are tracked clearly and closed on time.
 



 ·       Problems are communicated early and managed professionally before they become escalations.
 



 ·       Internal teams receive clear customer information, and customers receive one consistent version from Fresh Platter.
 



 ·       As Fresh Platter expands into more fruits, vegetables, customers and cities, the customer experience function scales through systems and processes rather than becoming person\-dependent.
 



  





**About Fresh Platter**



* Fresh Platter is a Bengaluru\-based, tech and data\-driven fresh produce company building a better farm\-to\-retail supply chain. Bananas are our current flagship category, and we are expanding across fresh produce. We work in a demanding operating environment where quality, timing, availability and commercial discipline matter every day \- and we want the experience of working with Fresh Platter to be as strong as the supply chain we are building.

title: Client Account Manager
description:
We are looking for a dynamic and detail\-oriented professional with a strong background in finance, accounting, and client management to drive the deployment of financial solutions for residential societies. The ideal candidate should be capable of handling client onboarding virtually, team coordination/handling, and issue resolution while ensuring smooth ERP and billing implementation.
 



  





  





**About the Role** 




 The role involves deploying financial and ERP solutions to digitize the operations and accounting functionalities of residential societies.
 



  





  





**Responsibilities** 



* Deploy financial and ERP solutions to digitize the operations and accounting functionalities of residential societies.
* Meet clients virtually and conduct product demonstrations and training sessions, emphasizing key features, benefits, and the overall value of the solution.
* Engage with Management Committee (MC) members to understand their requirements, business scope, and expectations.
* Prospect, educate, qualify, and generate new business opportunities while maintaining high customer satisfaction.
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams (Sales, ERP, VMS, and Support) to ensure seamless onboarding, implementation, and service delivery.
* Manage end\-to\-end ERP onboarding virtually, including configuration, billing setup, and post\-implementation support.
* Configure SaaS\-based billing modules, including:
* 
* Maintenance charge setup and recurring billing structure.
* Penalty/interest setup for overdue payments with automated rule application.
* Chart of Accounts (COA) configuration, ledger mapping, and accounting group creation.
* Bank account integration and reconciliation setup to ensure transaction accuracy.
* Payment gateway linking and testing for all billing modes (UPI, NEFT, CC/DC).
* Opening balance validation and migration of member financial data.
* Overall accounting setup to ensure real\-time and accurate financial reporting in the ERP system.
* 
* Ensure smooth coordination with the migration and billing teams to validate data accuracy and posting quality.
* Handle client escalations effectively by identifying root causes, ensuring timely resolutions, and maintaining positive relationships.
* Monitor billing cycles and postings to confirm timely invoice generation and payment tracking.
* Achieve defined monthly metrics and onboarding targets for the societies assigned.
* Contribute individually to onboarding and support for premium societies, especially for high\-value clients, as a Senior FSD.
* Document and share client feedback and implementation insights with product and tech teams to enhance ERP performance and customer experience.



  





  





**Qualifications** 



* Minimum 1–5 years of proven experience in deploying financial or ERP solutions with a consistent record of meeting performance targets.
* Strong accounting and finance background (e.g., BAF degree or equivalent qualification).
* Solid understanding of accounting principles, financial reporting, reconciliations, and billing processes.
* Hands\-on experience with ERP systems or financial management software, including configuration, implementation, and client support.



  





  





**Required Skills** 



* Proven experience in ERP onboarding and setup, including:
* SaaS\-based billing configuration and recurring maintenance charge setup.
* Penalty and interest rule configuration for overdue payments with automated calculation logic.
* Chart of Accounts (COA) design, ledger mapping, and accounting group structure creation.
* Bank account integration, payment gateway linking, and reconciliation setup to ensure accuracy and transparency.
* Validation and migration of opening balances, arrears, and advances for smooth transition during onboarding.
* Ensuring end\-to\-end accounting accuracy across income, expenses, advances, and dues within the ERP system.

title: Telecom Roaming Expert & Interconnect Partnerships
description:
**The world still has coverage blind spots. You could help eliminate them at Skylo.**
 Skylo has pioneered a standards\-based approach to satellite connectivity. We connect smartphones and IoT devices directly to satellites. No special hardware, no entirely new networks. Just billions of existing devices, suddenly reachable anywhere on Earth. We're not building toward this future. We're already in it.
   

  

 Our direct\-to\-device service is live on millions of activated devices across five continents, covering more than 72 million square kilometers, in partnership with leading satellite operators, mobile network operators, Tier\-1 chipset makers, and OEMs worldwide. And we're just getting started.
   

  

 At the heart of it all is Skylo's commercial NTN vRAN: a 3GPP standards\-based, cloud\-native platform that seamlessly bridges terrestrial and satellite networks. It's the infrastructure that makes true anywhere, anytime connectivity possible.
   

  

 When you join Skylo, you'll work at the intersection of three markets reshaping how the world stays connected: mass\-market consumer devices, automotive, and industrial IoT. Enabling people outdoors and critical workflows in the world's most remote places.
   

  

**This is a rare chance to work on technology that matters, at a company that's already proving it works**
*This role is located in Bangalore, India where we are onsite 3 days a week in office.*
**About The Role**
 We are seeking a senior commercial\-technical leader to own Skylo’s IPX, hubbing, and clearing\-partner ecosystem. You will be accountable for the contracts, operating cadence, service performance, escalation paths, and redundancy strategy that determine how quickly new roaming partners reach production.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Partner \& Vendor Management**
* Lifecycle Ownership: Manage and develop relationships with international roaming partner operators, owning the full lifecycle of the agreements.
* Connectivity Providers: Manage the relationship with international connectivity and signalling providers (IPX/GRX carriers, roaming hubs, SS7/Diameter signalling providers), including selection, contracting, and SLA monitoring.
* Clearing Houses: Manage the relationship with data and financial clearing houses and hub providers, monitoring billing, disputes, and reconciliations.


**Technical Coordination \& Operations**
* Testing \& Implementation: Coordinate the opening of new roaming relationships and testing.
* Data Exchange: Oversee the exchange of files and documentation between operators: TAP/RAP (Transferred/Returned Account Procedure), NRTRDE (Near Real Time Roaming Data Exchange), RAEX (IR.21, IR.85, IOT), and the related clearing and reconciliation processes.


**Strategy, Commercials \& Compliance**
* Contract Negotiation: Negotiate, draft, and maintain agreements, and manage the related signing and update process.
* Business Analytics: Analyse roaming performance (traffic, quality, revenue, cost, margin) and define optimisation strategies for tariffs, steering of roaming, and fraud management.
* Regulatory Compliance: Ensure compliance with applicable regulations and standards (e.g., GSMA, EU roaming regulation "Roam Like At Home”, and any local regulation), overseeing regulatory impacts on the business.
* Cross\-Functional Leadership: Interface with internal functions (Network, IT/BSS, Finance, Legal, Wholesale, Marketing) to ensure delivery and evolution of the service.


**Professional Experience**
**REQUIRED SKILLS \& QUALIFICATIONS**
* Industry Tenure: 10\+ years of experience in a roaming / wholesale roaming role within a mobile operator (or at a hub/IPX provider), with proven direct management of relationships with international operators and carriers.
* Interconnect Expertise: 10\+ years of experience in carrier interconnect, wholesale roaming, IPX/GRX, telecom vendor management, or a closely related field.
* Leadership Depth: Senior\-level ownership of strategic suppliers and complex partner relationships.


**Telecom \& Standards Knowledge**
* Roaming Business: In\-depth knowledge of the international roaming business: commercial models, value chain, tariff mechanisms (IOT, wholesale), steering, settlement, and clearing.
* GSMA Standards: Thorough knowledge of GSMA standards and procedures: RAEX/IR.21, AA.12, TAP/RAP, NRTRDE, BCE, IREG, and TADIG processes and workflows.


**Technical \& Systems Depth**
* Network Architecture: Solid understanding of the Network and IT aspects supporting roaming: 2G/3G/4G/5G architectures and network elements involved (HLR/HSS, UDM, MSC, SGSN/GGSN, MME, S/PGW, UPF, SMF, DRA, STP).
* Signaling \& Routing: Working depth in SS7/MAP and Diameter signalling, GT/point\-code and realm routing, DEA/STP, DNS, and IPX interconnect operations.
* Advanced Roaming: Strong knowledge of SMS interworking, VoLTE roaming (S8HR/LBO), and 5G roaming (SEPP).
* BSS/OSS Infrastructure: Knowledge of the supporting BSS/OSS systems (mediation, rating/charging, wholesale billing, clearing systems, TAP processing, fraud management, steering systems).


**Core Competencies \& Logistics**
* Business Acumen: Demonstrated success negotiating complex telecom agreements, pricing models, service levels, credits, and executive escalations.
* Problem Solving: Ability to turn ambiguous cross\-functional issues into structured governance and measurable outcomes, with strong analytical and coordination skills.
* Communication: Fluent English (written and spoken) is mandatory.
* Travel: Availability for international travel and participation in industry events/working groups (e.g., GSMA, bilateral partner meetings).


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Advanced Networking: Experience with NTN (Non\-Terrestrial Networks), NB\-IoT, IoT roaming, or rapidly scaling multi\-MNO networks.
* Visibility Tools: Familiarity with GSMA processes and signaling or network\-visibility platforms.
* Tooling: Experience with Jira, Confluence, Slack, partner portals, and operational scorecards.


**What We Offer**
 With employees working across three continents, Skylo is proud to be an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. Our worldwide and inclusive culture encourages a flexible approach to work, and we also offer an attractive range benefits such as:
   

  

* Competitive compensation packages including a stock option based equity program
* Comprehensive benefits plan
* Monthly allowances for wellness and education reimbursement
* A generous time off policy, holidays, and the opportunity to temporarily work abroad
* Once in a lifetime opportunity to be a part of developing and running world’s first commercial, live direct\-to\-device satellite network and service
* Access to world\-class team and talent across tech domains: software, hardware, chipsets, telecom, satellite and network virtualization
* Open, transparent, inclusive culture that blends the Silicon Valley, Nordic and South Asia characteristics


**EEO STATEMENT**
 Skylo is an equal\-opportunity employer and we celebrate diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, parent or caregiver status, political affiliation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws.
   

  

 We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. Please let us know if you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability.
