title: AI Transformation Manager
description:
**The Company**
 The Kantata Cloud for Professional Services™ gives businesses the clarity, control, and confidence they need to optimize resource planning and elevate operational performance. Our purpose\-built software is helping over 2,500 professional services organizations in more than 100 countries focus on and optimize their most important asset: their people. By leveraging Kantata, professionals gain access to the information and tools they need to win more business, ensure the right people are always available at the right time, and delight clients with exceptional project delivery and outcomes.
   

  

 Kantata is well\-capitalized, hiring, and growing our loyal and diversified customer base faster than we ever have. Most importantly, we have a clear vision of where we’re going and how to get there. (Hint: It involves you.) Did we mention that Kantata is also an awesome place to work? You’ll have the opportunity to work in a dynamic environment with a team that loves what they do. A talented team, great perks, and an amazing culture \= an employee\-rated Best Place to Work!
   

  

 Did we mention that Kantata is an awesome place to work? You’ll have the opportunity to work in an energetic environment with a smart team that loves what they do.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Kantata is building a connected customer journey spanning implementation, adoption, optimization, renewal, and expansion. We’re seeking an AI Transformation Manager to lead the application of AI, automation, and workflow redesign across our post\-sales organization.
   

  

 You will own a portfolio of AI transformation initiatives from opportunity discovery through adoption and measurable business impact. Working across Professional Services, Customer Success, CX Operations, Digital Engagement, Education Services, and Renewals, you will redesign workflows, build and test solutions, lead pilots, and scale what works.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on transformation role—not a research or traditional project\-management position. You’ll be expected to turn business problems into solutions that teams trust and use.
   

  

 What You’ll Do
   

  

* Develop and manage the internal post\-sales AI transformation roadmap.
* Identify and prioritize opportunities based on customer impact, business value, feasibility, risk, and time to value.
* Map and redesign workflows to reduce manual work, improve handoffs, accelerate cycle times, and strengthen customer continuity.
* Build prototypes and lightweight solutions using approved AI, agent\-building, and no\-code or low\-code tools.
* Lead initiatives from discovery and requirements through testing, launch, adoption, and optimization.
* Partner with IT, Engineering, Data, Security, and governance teams to transition successful prototypes into secure, scalable solutions.
* Create reusable AI plays, prompts, agents, and digital experiences that extend team capacity.
* Lead training, communications, documentation, and champion programs that drive sustained adoption.
* Establish appropriate human oversight, quality standards, monitoring, and exception processes.
* Measure adoption and business impact, including capacity released, cycle\-time improvements, customer outcomes, cost to serve, and renewal readiness.
* Communicate portfolio priorities, progress, risks, and results to executive leadership.


 Initial opportunities may include implementation automation, customer\-health insights, next\-best\-action recommendations, AI\-generated customer review preparation, renewal\-risk detection, and role\-based copilots.
   

  

 What You Bring
   

  

* 7\+ years of experience in business transformation, product or program management, operations, professional services, customer success, revenue operations, or a related field; B2B SaaS experience is strongly preferred.
* A track record of redesigning and scaling cross\-functional processes with measurable business results.
* Strong knowledge of the post\-sales customer lifecycle, including implementation, adoption, value realization, renewal, and expansion.
* Practical experience applying generative AI, workflow automation, copilots, agentic workflows, or no\-code and low\-code tools to real business processes.
* A product mindset with strengths in problem framing, user discovery, prioritization, experimentation, adoption, and outcome measurement.
* Familiarity with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, Gainsight, PSA systems, support tools, product analytics, learning platforms, or knowledge systems.
* Strong analytical judgment and the ability to build business cases, establish baselines, and quantify value.
* Experience leading organizational change and influencing teams without direct authority.
* Sound judgment regarding data quality, privacy, security, responsible AI, and human oversight.
* Excellent written, verbal, facilitation, and executive communication skills.


**Preferred Experience**
* Leading an AI, automation, transformation, or center\-of\-excellence portfolio.
* Working with PSA platforms or services\-oriented SaaS businesses.
* Building workflows with tools such as Workato, Zapier, Make, n8n, Power Automate, Retool, Glean, or comparable platforms.
* Moving prototypes into secure, monitored production environments with Engineering or IT.
* Applying Lean, service design, process mining, change management, or value\-stream mapping.
* Understanding services P\&L, utilization, and delivery\-efficiency metrics.


 How You’ll Work
   

  

 You are a customer\-focused systems thinker and hands\-on builder. You can move from an executive roadmap discussion to a frontline workflow session, create a practical first version, test it with users, and apply the rigor required to scale it responsibly.
   

  

 Why This Role Matters
   

  

 AI is central to Kantata’s vision for delivering exceptional customer outcomes without linear headcount growth. This role offers the opportunity to shape how AI transforms post\-sales operations, with executive sponsorship and broad cross\-functional partnership.
   

  

 Kantata offers competitive compensation and benefits, flexible time off, a remote\-first environment, and professional\-development support. Benefits are based on location and applicable local programs.
   

  

 Kantata is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

 Working closely with the Account Director, on\-account functional leads and key client stakeholders, this role serves as the central point of accountability for performance reporting, contract governance, quality assurance and team administration. title: IT Head
description:
**Head of IT \& Software Development**

**FABDIZ Interiors \& Architecture** 

About the Role

FABDIZ and FABCURO are growing premium brands in the interiors, architecture, luxury wall décor, and artefacts space. We are looking for an experienced **Head of IT \& Software Development** to lead our technology and software development function.

This role is ideal for a **Software Development / Engineering leader** who has progressed into a technology leadership position and understands how to build, manage, improve, and scale business\-critical software systems.

You will be responsible for leading the development team, managing our existing technology infrastructure and applications, developing new software solutions, integrating business systems, and ensuring that technology supports the company's growth.

We are looking for someone who can **understand business requirements, guide technical teams, make practical technology decisions, and personally contribute to solving complex software and IT problems when required.**

Your Key Responsibilities1\. Software Development \& Technology

* Lead the overall software development and IT function.
* Manage the development, maintenance, and improvement of business applications.
* Plan and execute the company's technology roadmap.
* Ensure software applications are reliable, secure, scalable, and easy to maintain.
* Review existing systems and identify areas for improvement.
* Guide the team on architecture, coding standards, development practices, and technology choices.
* Oversee development of websites, internal applications, portals, CRM systems, ERP integrations, and other business software.
* Manage third\-party software, APIs, integrations, and technology vendors.
* Ensure proper documentation, version control, testing, deployment, and backup processes.

2\. Team Leadership

* Lead, mentor, and manage the software development / IT team.
* Allocate projects and responsibilities based on team capabilities.
* Set development standards and timelines.
* Review team performance and provide technical and managerial guidance.
* Build a strong culture of ownership, accountability, quality, and continuous learning.
* Work closely with senior management to communicate project progress, challenges, and technology requirements.

3\. Business Applications

You will oversee technology solutions supporting areas such as:

* CRM and lead management
* Sales and quotation systems
* Project management
* Customer and vendor portals
* Internal business applications
* ERP and accounting integrations
* Marketing and sales systems
* Inventory / operations systems
* Reporting and management dashboards
* Website and e\-commerce platforms
* API and third\-party integrations

4\. IT Infrastructure \& Security

* Oversee cloud infrastructure and hosting.
* Ensure website and application security.
* Manage access controls, backups, monitoring, and disaster recovery.
* Coordinate with external IT / infrastructure vendors where required.
* Ensure systems remain stable, secure, and available for business operations.
* Establish appropriate IT policies, processes, and technology standards.

5\. Automation \& AI

* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive business processes.
* Evaluate and implement practical AI tools where they provide genuine business value.
* Support integration of AI into sales, marketing, customer service, reporting, and internal workflows.
* Work with the development team to integrate APIs and automation platforms.

**The role does not require you to be an AI specialist. Strong software development and technology leadership experience is the primary requirement.**

What We're Looking ForExperience

* **8\+ years of experience in Software Development / IT / Engineering.**
* Proven experience in a **Software Development Manager, Engineering Manager, Head of IT, Head of Engineering, Technical Lead, or similar leadership role.**
* Strong experience managing software development teams.
* Experience building and managing business\-critical applications.
* Experience handling multiple software projects simultaneously.
* Strong understanding of software development life cycle (SDLC).
* Experience working directly with business stakeholders and senior management.
* Experience managing external technology vendors and development partners is an advantage.

Technical Background

Candidates should come from a **strong software development background** and have practical understanding of several of the following:

* React / Angular / Vue
* Node.js / Python / PHP / Laravel / Java / .NET
* REST APIs
* SQL / MySQL / PostgreSQL
* MongoDB or other NoSQL databases
* Cloud platforms – AWS / Azure / Google Cloud
* Git / GitHub
* CI/CD
* Docker
* Web application architecture
* API integrations
* CRM / ERP integrations
* Website development and management
* Application security
* Cloud infrastructure

**You do not need to be an expert in every technology listed above. We are primarily looking for strong software engineering fundamentals, leadership ability, and the capability to understand and manage modern technology systems.**

Leadership \& Business Skills

We are looking for someone who:

* Can lead and motivate a technical team.
* Takes complete ownership of technology projects.
* Can translate business requirements into practical technology solutions.
* Can communicate technical matters clearly to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Is comfortable working directly with senior management.
* Can prioritize projects based on business impact.
* Understands budgets, timelines, resources, and technology trade\-offs.
* Is hands\-on enough to understand technical challenges.
* Can build processes and discipline within a development team.
* Solves problems proactively rather than waiting for instructions.
* Is comfortable working in a fast\-growing and changing business environment.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 6–12 months, you will be expected to:

* Establish strong processes for software development and IT management.
* Improve the stability and performance of existing applications.
* Build and strengthen the software development team.
* Deliver important business applications and integrations.
* Reduce dependency on manual processes through automation.
* Improve reporting and visibility for management.
* Strengthen application and IT security.
* Improve development quality, documentation, testing, and deployment processes.
* Create a practical technology roadmap aligned with business growth.
* Introduce AI and automation where it creates measurable business value.

Education

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field preferred.
* Relevant professional experience may be considered in place of formal qualifications.

Industry Experience

Experience in any of the following industries will be an advantage:

* Interior Design
* Architecture
* Furniture
* Luxury Retail
* Home Décor
* E\-commerce
* SaaS
* PropTech
* Retail
* Manufacturing
* Digital / Technology Services

**However, industry experience is not mandatory. Strong software development and leadership experience is more important.**

Why Join FABDIZ \& FABCURO?

* Lead the technology function of two growing premium brands.
* Work directly with the leadership team.
* Build software that has a direct impact on business operations.
* Lead and grow a technology team.
* Have significant ownership and decision\-making responsibility.
* Work on real\-world software, automation, integrations, and business technology.
* Opportunity to shape the company's technology roadmap as the business scales.

Pay: ₹1,800,000\.00 \- ₹2,200,000\.00 per year

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Paid time off

Ability to commute/relocate:

title: End User Training Consultant
description:
**End User Training Consultant**
================================

**Blue Yonder Supply Chain Solutions**

**Position Overview**
---------------------


The **End User Training (EUT) Consultant** is a client\-facing learning and enablement professional who supports the design, development, and delivery of learning programs for Blue Yonder supply chain transformations. Working with Senior and Principal EUT Consultants, this role helps customers build the knowledge, skills, and confidence needed to successfully adopt new technologies, processes, and ways of working.


The EUT Consultant combines **instructional design, content development, facilitation, customer enablement, and consulting skills** to translate business processes, system functionality, roles, and organizational impacts into practical, role\-based learning experiences.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Support EUT activities and deliverables across enterprise supply chain transformation programs.
* Conduct and support **learning discovery, stakeholder interviews, learning needs assessments, and role\-based training analysis**.
* Partner with customer stakeholders to understand business objectives, operational processes, learner needs, and implementation requirements.
* Translate business processes, solution functionality, roles, and change impacts into **learning objectives and role\-based learning requirements**.
* Support development of **training plans, curricula, learning journeys, course outlines, content development plans, and training schedules**.
* Design and develop instructor\-led, virtual, blended, digital, and performance\-support learning materials.
* Develop presentations, facilitator guides, participant materials, exercises, scenarios, job aids, videos, assessments, and other learning resources.
* Customize learning content and examples to reflect customer business processes, use cases, roles, and implementation objectives.
* Apply **adult learning, instructional design, learning experience, and content development best practices**.
* Apply foundational **Organizational Change Management principles** to understand how business and role impacts, readiness, communications, and adoption influence learning requirements.
* Deliver **instructor\-led, virtual instructor\-led, workshops, knowledge\-transfer, and customer enablement sessions**.
* Facilitate interactive and hands\-on learning experiences aligned with customer use cases and operational processes.
* Adapt learning and facilitation approaches for different audiences, including **business users, super users, system administrators, support teams, managers, and leaders**.
* Support **train\-the\-trainer, super\-user enablement, instructor readiness, and knowledge\-transfer activities**.
* Help customers build user proficiency, confidence, and greater self\-sufficiency in using implemented solutions.
* Work with functional and solution experts to ensure learning accurately reflects configured solutions and future\-state business processes.
* Participate in curriculum design, content review, validation, and training readiness sessions.
* Follow established content\-development, quality, version\-control, review, and approval processes.
* Work collaboratively with **OCM, project management, Professional Services, solution, product, Customer Success, Education, and client teams** to align learning with implementation milestones and business outcomes.
* Maintain EUT work plans, content trackers, review logs, and supporting project documentation.
* Support development of **learning assessments and evaluation approaches** and analyze learner feedback, training effectiveness, and adoption indicators.
* Use feedback, product enhancements, and implementation lessons learned to continuously improve learning content and delivery.
* Contribute lessons learned, templates, examples, best practices, and ideas that support **continuous improvement and standardization of EUT methodologies and delivery assets**.
* Develop knowledge of Blue Yonder solutions, supply chain processes, implementation methodologies, and enterprise transformation.

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

* **3\+ years of experience in end\-user training, Learning \& Development, instructional design, customer enablement, software implementation, professional services, or a related discipline.**
* Experience designing and developing training content for **enterprise software, SaaS platforms, business applications, or digital transformation initiatives**.
* Experience delivering instructor\-led, virtual instructor\-led, or other facilitated learning experiences.
* Foundational knowledge of **adult learning, instructional design, curriculum development, and training content development practices**.
* Understanding of the relationship between **Organizational Change Management, business readiness, learning, and end\-user adoption**.
* Ability to understand both **business\-process and technology concepts** and translate complex information into clear, practical learning experiences.
* Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, facilitation, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Ability to establish effective working relationships with customers, subject matter experts, solution consultants, and project stakeholders.
* Ability to manage multiple learning deliverables, reviews, schedules, and priorities in a consulting environment.
* Professional, adaptable, self\-directed, and customer\-focused approach to delivery.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* **Experience with or exposure to Blue Yonder solutions or other enterprise supply chain solutions and platforms.**
* Experience in **supply chain, retail, manufacturing, logistics, planning, warehouse operations, transportation, or related business environments**.
* Experience supporting learning and enablement for supply chain capabilities such as **Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Inventory Optimization, Integrated Business Planning, Allocation and Replenishment, Warehouse Management, Transportation Management, or related solutions**.
* Experience supporting software implementations or broader business transformation programs.
* Experience facilitating workshops, stakeholder discussions, hands\-on learning, knowledge\-transfer, or train\-the\-trainer programs.
* Familiarity with Prosci, ADKAR, SAP Activate, or other Organizational Change Management approaches.
* Experience with learning management systems, content development tools, digital learning, video, simulation, or related learning technologies.
* Professional services, enterprise software, or consulting experience.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------


Success means consistently delivering **high\-quality, customer\-focused learning experiences** that build learner proficiency and confidence, support successful knowledge transfer, and contribute to solution adoption and implementation success.


The EUT Consultant is expected to progressively develop from executing defined learning activities into independently conducting discovery, designing learning solutions, facilitating client sessions, advising stakeholders, and managing increasingly complex EUT deliverables.


Success is demonstrated through **training effectiveness, learner proficiency, customer satisfaction, stakeholder relationships, solution adoption, and consistent delivery quality**, while contributing to continuous improvement of EUT methodologies and learning assets.

**Our Values**

  

If you want to know the heart of a company, take a look at their values. Ours unite us. They are what drive our success – and the success of our customers. Does your heart beat like ours? Find out here: Core Values


All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

At Nexla, our culture is built around our core values: **Have Empathy**, **Be Curious**, **Be Intellectually Honest**, **Achieve Excellence**, and **Remember to Relax**. We put our customers at the heart of everything we do, foster a data\-driven mindset, take ownership of our work, and believe in the power of teamwork to achieve ambitious goals.

### **Role, briefly**



Our Customer Success team owns the end\-to\-end client experience, from initial integration through enterprise adoption and expansion. It is a small team, and this role does two jobs at once: running your own enterprise accounts, and leading, mentoring, and coaching the CSMs around you. You work closely with Sales, Solutions, Engineering, and executive leadership, and you are the primary voice of the customer internally, including on where the platform goes next.



Our Customer Success team owns the end\-to\-end client experience, from initial integration through enterprise adoption and expansion. It is a small team, and this role does two jobs at once: running your own enterprise accounts, and leading, mentoring, and coaching the CSMs around you. You work closely with Sales, Solutions, Engineering, and executive leadership, and you are the primary voice of the customer internally, including on where the platform goes next. As part of a lean and high\-impact team, you will directly manage a portfolio of 10\-15 strategic enterprise accounts, guiding them through both initial onboarding and long\-term customer success.


### **What you'll own**


* Retention and expansion across your accounts. That starts at onboarding, overseeing complex implementations alongside our Solutions Engineers and Architects, including vector pipeline setup into existing customer infrastructure, and runs through renewals, upsells, and SOWs with Sales.
* The standard of work across the CS team. Coaching and mentoring the CSMs, and owning the playbooks, health\-score frameworks, and retention strategies they run on. The function has to scale as the company grows.
* Executive relationships at your accounts. C\-level sponsors, VP\-level data owners, and AI steering committees, aligned on business value and ROI. You run the Executive Business Reviews and technical workshops.
* What happens when things go wrong. You are the escalation point for critical issues, technical roadblocks, and at\-risk accounts, pulling in engineering and leadership and keeping it calm.


*AI tooling is part of the job here, not a side interest. Customer communication, health tracking, and account reporting are all places we expect you to use it.*


*Ninety days : You will have fully onboarded your initial pod of strategic enterprise accounts, audited and leveled up our CS playbooks. You will have joined key customer calls to assess health across your 10–15 enterprise accounts, identified the next set of strategic and tactical deliverables for each, and established clear coaching cadence and updated playbooks for the team.*


### **The hard problem**



Because Nexla's enterprise platform bridges deep data engineering (ETL/ELT, APIs, streaming) with cutting\-edge AI architectures (agentic workflows, RAG, and MCP servers), the core tension in this role is balancing technical execution with high\-level value creation.


### **Must\-haves**

title: Technical Support Engineer (Customer Engagement Specialist)
description:
**Technical Support Engineer (Customer Engagement Specialist), Enterprise LMS**

**Location:** Chenai  
**Experience:** 5 to 12 years  
**Function:** Product and Customer Engagement

**About the role**

This is not a ticket\-routing job.

**PeopleOne** which is earlier called as **ExpertusONE** is an enterprise learning platform used by global organisations to run compliance training, certification programs, instructor\-led and virtual sessions, and skills development at scale across tens of thousands of learners. When something behaves unexpectedly in an environment like that, the question is rarely "did the user click the wrong button." It is usually a configuration interaction, an integration payload, a permissions model edge case, or a genuine defect hiding behind three layers of plausible explanations.

We are looking for someone who can tell the difference, and prove it.

You will own customer\-reported issues end to end: reproduce them, isolate the root cause, resolve what can be resolved through configuration or guidance, and hand the rest to Engineering with a diagnosis sharp enough that they can start fixing instead of start investigating. You are the person who makes the difference between a bug report that says "enrollment is broken for this customer" and one that says "enrollment fails when a training plan has sequencing enforced and the learner holds a prior exempted module, here is the reproduction path, here are the three affected tenants, here is the query that identifies them."

***If you enjoy the puzzle more than the ticket count, read on...***

**What you will do**

**Investigate and diagnose**

* Take ownership of escalated customer issues across the platform: enrollments, training plans, compliance and certification workflows, ILT and virtual classroom sessions, content playback (SCORM, xAPI, AICC, cmi5\), reporting and analytics, notifications, mobile, and integrations.
* Reproduce issues in test environments. Establish what is configuration, what is data, what is expected behaviour that the customer did not expect, and what is a genuine defect.
* Query production data (read\-only) to quantify blast radius: how many learners, which tenants, since when, and under what conditions.
* Read application and integration logs, trace API request and response payloads, and inspect webhook and SSO flows to isolate where a transaction actually failed.
* Distinguish correlation from causation. The most recent change is not automatically the cause.

**Resolve and communicate**

* Resolve issues directly where the fix is configuration, data correction, workflow redesign, or customer enablement.
* Write customer\-facing responses that a non\-technical LMS administrator can act on: what happened, what the impact is, what we are doing, what they need to do, and by when.
* Manage expectations honestly on issues that will not be fixed quickly. Vague reassurance is worse than an inconvenient timeline.
* Run live troubleshooting sessions with customer administrators and IT teams, including screen shares with enterprise security and identity teams.

**Escalate with a prognosis, not a summary**

* Package defects for Engineering with a reproduction path, environment details, affected versions and tenants, log evidence, expected versus actual behaviour, and a stated hypothesis on root cause.
* Assign severity and business impact yourself, and defend that assessment. Everything is not a P1\.
* Stay attached to the issue through to resolution. Escalation is a handoff of ownership for the fix, not a handoff of ownership for the customer.

**Improve the system**

* Identify recurring issue patterns and drive them to permanent elimination: product change, documentation gap, onboarding defect, or default configuration problem.
* Build and maintain internal diagnostic runbooks and customer\-facing knowledge articles. Reduce the number of issues that need you at all.
* Feed themes and evidence back into the product roadmap. You will have a direct line to Product Management and your input is expected to be substantiated with data, not anecdote.

**What success looks like**

**By 90 days:** You are independently resolving escalated issues across at least three functional areas without shadowing. Your defect reports are accepted by Engineering without a round trip for missing information.

**By six months:** Your average escalated\-to\-Engineering rate is falling because you are resolving more at source. You have shipped knowledge articles or runbooks that measurably reduce repeat issues. You have raised at least two product changes that were accepted onto the roadmap.

**By twelve months:** You are the person other engineers and CSMs come to when an issue does not make sense. You are trusted to speak directly to enterprise customers during a severity incident without supervision.

**What you need**

**Non\-negotiable:**

* **5 to 12 years** in technical support, application support, product support engineering, or solutions engineering for a B2B SaaS or enterprise software product. **Consumer support and pure L1 experience will not transfer.**
* Working SQL. You must be able to write joins, aggregations, and filtered queries against a relational schema to investigate an issue yourself, without asking an engineer.
* Practical fluency with REST APIs: reading documentation, constructing requests, interpreting status codes and error payloads, and using Postman or an equivalent tool.
* Demonstrated ability to read application logs and trace a transaction across systems.
* Structured diagnostic reasoning. You form a hypothesis, test it, and discard it when the evidence disagrees.
* Written English strong enough for direct communication with enterprise customers in EMEA and North America.
* Comfort with ambiguity and with saying "I do not know yet, here is how I will find out."

**Strongly preferred:**

* Prior experience with an LMS, LXP, HCM, or talent management platform (Cornerstone, Docebo, Absorb, SuccessFactors Learning, Workday Learning, Saba, or similar).
* Understanding of e\-learning standards: SCORM 1\.2 and 2004, xAPI, AICC, cmi5, and LRS concepts.
* Enterprise integration experience: SAML and OIDC single sign\-on, SCIM provisioning, HRIS data feeds, webhooks, and file\-based imports.
* Exposure to BI or reporting tools (Superset, Tableau, Power BI) and the ability to validate a reporting discrepancy against source data.
* Experience supporting multi\-tenant SaaS, including the reasoning required to separate tenant\-specific configuration issues from platform defects.
* BE, BTech, MCA, or equivalent technical education. We care more about what you can do than where you learned it.

**What we are not looking for**

To save everyone time:

* This role does not involve reading from a script or routing tickets to a queue.
* This is not a Customer Success Manager role. It is not primarily about renewals, QBRs, or adoption metrics, although you will work closely with the people who own those.
* If your last three years have been spent exclusively in a tier\-one queue with a strict escalation\-after\-fifteen\-minutes policy, this will be a difficult jump.
* If you are looking for a step towards a pure development role, be honest about that in the interview and we will tell you honestly whether this is the right path.

**How we evaluate**

Beyond conversation, we will put a real anonymised issue in front of you: a description, some log output, and a data extract. We will ask you to tell us what you think is happening and what you would check next. We are assessing how you reason, not whether you already know our product.

**Why this role is worth your time**

You will get read\-only production access, direct access to Engineering, and a direct line into Product Management where your findings shape what gets built. You will work on genuinely complex enterprise problems for recognisable global customers. And you will be measured on whether problems stay solved, not on how many tickets you closed.

If you're interested, please share your resume with **swethav@peopleone.co** or apply directly through this job post.

**We look forward to connecting with talented professionals and wish you the very best in your career journey!**

**Company Description**
 At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content \- wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.
   

  

**Job Description**
 As the primary point of contact for assigned customers and partners within Gracenote, this role involves comprehensive relationship management. The position requires proactive communication, troubleshooting, and quality management, while also focusing on upsell opportunities and customer health. Key responsibilities include handling escalations, developing action plans, managing reports and dashboards, coordinating product updates and integrations, and maintaining customer\-specific playbooks. This role demands a blend of customer service, industry expertise, and strategic thinking to ensure customer satisfaction and to drive business growth.
   

  

**As a Customer Success Manager You Will**
* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned customers and partners
* Establish and maintain regular check\-ins, including dashboard and report reviews
* Create and deliver Quarterly Business Review (QBR) presentations, documenting highlights and action items.
* Monitor and ensure adherence to contractual commitments, including SLAs
* Stay informed and drive engagement around upcoming renewals
* Gather valuable feedback on customer/partner strategic goals and recommend solutions for customer use cases with a focus on upsell opportunities
* Provide input on overall customer and partner health
* Handle quality escalations and issues unresolved through standard Customer Care processes, collaborating with internal departments to ensure timely resolution and preventive measures.
* Initiate and monitor action plans for identified quality trends and provide regular progress updates to customers/partners
* Identify customers to receive standard Customer Dashboards, Quality Reports, and Product Usage Reports
* Coordinate setup of non\-standard customer reports and dashboards as needed
* Review key performance indicators (KPIs) regularly with customers/partners
* Communicate essential details to customers/partners about product retirements and replacement solutions
* Ensure customer readiness for new product features integration
* Create Product Inquiry tickets and coordinate customer responses
* Create and maintain customer and partner\-specific playbooks


**Qualifications**
* Previous experience working in an account management role demonstrating successful customer satisfaction and relationship management outcomes
* Fluent English
* Excellent verbal and written communication abilities for interacting with customers, partners, and internal teams.
* Ability to identify, analyze, and resolve complex issues and find mutually beneficial solutions
* Solid Presentation skills
* Strong attention to detail
* Ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple responsibilities efficiently
* Flexibility to handle various customer needs and changing product landscapes
* Experience recommending solutions and identifying upsell opportunities, a plus
* Proficiency in creating and maintaining documentation
* Experience guiding customers and partners through changes
* Data analysis experience, including the ability to interpret and present data
* Working knowledge of business software/applications \- Google Suite, Microsoft Office Suite


**Additional Information**
 Please be aware that job\-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

title: Technical Account Manager
description:
Bentley Systems
   

  

**Technical Account Manager**
**Location:** 
 Hybrid \- Mumbai
   

  

**Position Summary**
 Bentley Systems seeks a dynamic Technical Account Manager (TAM) to collaborate closely with the Account Manager (AM) in driving goals through effectively managing the technical relationship and strategy for Bentley's most strategic accounts. As a global leader in infrastructure software, Bentley Systems provides cutting\-edge solutions that empower users in infrastructure projects.
   

  

 The TAM defines the technical account strategy by combining the appropriate sales methodology, deep industry, and technical background to align with sales initiatives while advocating for the customer within Bentley by partnering with sales, product, user success, consulting, and marketing to provide a clear understanding of the customer's environment, challenges, and requirements. The TAM fosters long\-term partnerships and expansion with customers and net new customer acquisition within each customer's ecosystem. The TAM aligns the customer's business projects and technical goals with Bentley's vision, mission, and strategy.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Work closely with Account Managers and users to develop technical account strategies and compelling value propositions.
* Collaborate with Account Managers to run discovery sessions, identify user value, gather requirements, and with support for Solution Engineering colleagues, propose tailored infrastructure software solutions.
* Document the technical roadmap for the account plan and contribute to account reviews.
* Cultivate strong relationships with key technical stakeholders within assigned account(s), fostering trust as a go\-to subject matter expert resource with credibility and a positive reputation.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with Product Management, Enterprise Success and Marketing to align technical and business requirements, share user insights, identify product enhancement opportunities, new go\-to\-market solutions and contribute to the continuous improvement of Bentley's software offerings.
* Engage with partners as an extension of the Bentley sales organization.
* Deliver and coordinate technical presentations, demonstrations and showcasing the value and functionality of Bentley’s software solutions.
* Coordinate a response to technical questions, concerns, and objections raised by accounts, while highlighting the benefits and competitive advantages of the company's solutions.
* Contribute to compelling technical proposals, documentation, and responses to RFPs working with AE and SA.
* Stay current with industry trends, emerging technologies, and competitive offerings to provide informed recommendations and insights to the sales team and accounts.


**Qualification**
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, Technology, or a related field, preferably structural and offshore infrastructure\-related background.
* 7\+ years of technical sales experience in the infrastructure industry, with additional knowledge or experience in the Engineering, Construction, or Design industry.
* Knowledge of SACS, STAAD and Plant Design tools will be beneficial
* Experience deploying new technology into a workforce to inspire innovation, change, and efficiency.
* Deep knowledge of Bentley Systems solutions
* Travel requirement up to 50%.


**What We Offer**
* A great Team and culture – please see our colleague video.
* An exciting career as an integral part of a world\-leading software company providing solutions for architecture, engineering, and construction \- watch this short documentary about how we got our start.
* An attractive salary and benefits package.
* A commitment to inclusion, belonging and colleague wellbeing through global initiatives and resource groups.
* A company committed to making a real difference by advancing the world’s infrastructure for better quality of life, where your contributions help build a more sustainable, connected, and resilient world. Discover our latest user success stories for an insight into our global impact.


 
 **About Bentley Systems**
 Around the world, infrastructure professionals rely on software from Bentley Systems to help them design, build, and operate better and more resilient infrastructure for transportation, water, energy, cities, and more. Founded in 1984 by engineers for engineers, Bentley is the partner of choice for engineering firms and owner\-operators worldwide, with software that spans engineering disciplines, industry sectors, and all phases of the infrastructure lifecycle. Through our digital twin solutions, we help infrastructure professionals unlock the value of their data to transform project delivery and asset performance. www.bentley.com
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
 Bentley is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and considers for employment all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, gender/gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, marital status, religion/belief, national origin, caste, age, or any other characteristic protected by local law or unrelated to job qualifications.

* Conflict resolution
* Negotiation
* Influencing
* Relationship management
* Strong communication

**Working Environment**
-----------------------

* Globally distributed team
* Fast\-paced and rapidly growing organization
* Friendly and inclusive environment
* Culture of collaboration, autonomy, innovation, and proactive leadership
* Opportunity to work on transformative technology projects
**The Accurate Way:**
=====================


We offer a fun, fast\-paced environment, with lots of room for growth. We have an unwavering commitment to diversity, ensuring everyone has a complete sense of belonging here. To do this, we follow four guiding principles – Take Ownership, Be Open, Stay Curious, Work as One – core values that dictate what we stand for, and how we behave.

  



**Take ownership.**
===================


Be accountable for your actions, your team, and the company. Accept responsibility willingly, especially when it’s what’s best for our customers. Give others every reason to trust you, believe in you, and count on you. Rise to every occasion with your personal best.


**Be open.**
============


Be open to new ideas. Be inclusive of people and ways of doing things. Make yourself accessible and approachable, and communicate with genuineness, transparency, honesty, and respect. Embrace differences.

**Stay curious.**
=================


Stay curious even as you move forward. Tirelessly ask questions and challenge the status quo in your pursuit of new ideas, ways to solve problems, and to continually grow and improve.

**Work as one.**
================


Work together to create the best customer and workplace experience. Put our customers and employees first—before individual or departmental agendas. Make sure they get the help they need to succeed.

**Equal opportunities**
=======================


Accurate is an equal\-opportunity employer and is committed to hiring talented and qualified individuals with diverse backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

  

Accurate will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws.

  

You must have a right to work in Australia indefinitely that does not involve sponsorship by the Company.

**Special Notice:**
===================


Accurate is aware of schemes involving fraudulent job postings/offers and/or individuals or entities claiming to be employees of Accurate. Those involved are offering fabricated employment opportunities to applicants, often asking for sensitive personal and financial information. If you believe you have been contacted by anyone misrepresenting themselves as an employee of Accurate, please contact humanresources@accurate.com.

* Please be advised that all legitimate correspondence from an Accurate employee will come from "@accurate.com" email accounts.

* Accurate will not interview candidates via text or email. Our interviews are conducted by recruiters and leaders via the phone, Zoom/Teams or in an in\-person format.

* Accurate will never ask candidates to make any type of personal financial investment related to gaining employment with the Company.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.


### **Role Purpose**



Lead MWM’s direct commercial development in India by identifying, developing and closing new equipment and lifecycle service opportunities with end users and other direct project stakeholders. The Territory Manager will establish MWM as a visible, technically credible and commercially responsive partner in the Indian power generation market, with priority on gas engine generator applications.


**This is a direct market role.**The position is not responsible for building or managing a dealership network. The successful candidate will create demand, own strategic customer relationships, and lead opportunities directly for MWM, while coordinating qualified EPCs, engineering firms, and service providers on a project\-specific basis as required.


### **Key Responsibilities**


* Own MWM’s direct sales development across India for gas engine generator sets, power modules, combined heat and power solutions, and related lifecycle offerings.
* Build and manage a strong pipeline of direct opportunities with industrial end users, utilities, independent power producers, data centers, oil and gas companies, petrochemical and chemical plants, steel, cement, mining, food and beverage, textiles, pharmaceuticals, commercial infrastructure and other energy\-intensive industries.
* Develop strategic account plans for priority customers and convert market potential into qualified projects, tenders, orders and long\-term customer relationships.
* Engage early with customer decision\-makers, plant engineering teams, consultants, EPC organizations and project developers to position MWM during concept development, feasibility studies, FEED and specification stages.
* Lead the complete opportunity cycle from prospecting and qualification through application definition, solution positioning, proposal development, negotiation, order intake and structured handover.
* Translate customer operating requirements into clear technical\-commercial inputs, including fuel composition, gas pressure, site conditions, load profile, operating mode, heat recovery requirements, installation concept and commissioning expectations.
* Coordinate closely with application engineering, quotation, project management, service, finance, legal, and commercial teams to prepare compliant and competitive solutions.
* Lead value\-based selling by quantifying customer benefits such as fuel efficiency, availability, lifecycle cost, emissions performance, operational flexibility and serviceability.
* Develop and maintain relationships with relevant EPCs, consultants and engineering companies as project influencers and execution partners, without assigning dealer or territory rights.
* Identify service, overhaul, long\-term maintenance, upgrade, spare parts, and installed\-base opportunities that strengthen customer lifecycle value.
* Maintain accurate opportunity, forecast, customer and activity data in the company CRM system and provide clear monthly outlooks, risks, actions and market intelligence.
* Represent MWM at targeted customer workshops, technical seminars, industry associations, conferences and exhibitions in India.
* Monitor competitive activity, pricing dynamics, regulations, gas availability, segment trends, and customer investment plans, and convert findings into actionable sales priorities.
* Achieve agreed order intake, revenue, margin, pipeline quality and strategic account development objectives while following internal governance and approval processes.

### **Target Candidate Profile**


* 8 to 12 years of progressive experience in technical B2B sales, business development or key\-account management in the Indian power generation market.
* Preferred experience with gas engine generators, reciprocating engine power plants, cogeneration or trigeneration, distributed energy, captive power, waste\-to\-energy, biogas, natural gas, special gas or hybrid power solutions.
* Demonstrated success in direct selling to end users and managing complex, project\-based sales cycles with multiple technical and commercial stakeholders.
* Established market access and customer relationships in one or more priority segments such as industrial captive power, oil and gas, petrochemicals, data centers, utilities, infrastructure, manufacturing or process industries.
* Strong understanding of the Indian project ecosystem, including direct customers, EPCs, consultants, tender processes, regulatory considerations and commercial practices.
* Ability to engage at plant, engineering, procurement, finance, and senior management levels and to build credibility with both technical and commercial decision\-makers.
* Commercial ownership, disciplined follow\-up and a proven ability to progress opportunities from early\-stage lead to signed order.
* Willingness to travel extensively within India and, when required, internationally for customer meetings, factory visits, training and business reviews.

### **Education**



Preferred degrees:


* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, power engineering, energy engineering, or a closely related technical discipline.
* B.E. or B. Tech is preferred. An M.E., MTech, or an MBA in Sales, Marketing, Strategy, or General Management is advantageous.
* Candidates with another relevant engineering degree may be considered where supported by strong, directly relevant power\-generation sales experience.

### **Technical and Commercial Knowledge**


* Working knowledge of gas engines, generator sets, alternators, balance of plant, electrical integration and power plant operating concepts.
* Understanding of captive power, grid\-parallel and island operation, base\-load applications, CHP or CCHP, containerized and powerhouse installations, and high\-ambient site conditions.
* Ability to interpret customer specifications, single\-line concepts, fuel\-gas data, load profiles and technical\-commercial tender requirements.
* Competence in solution selling, financial justification, contract negotiation, risk identification, pricing discipline and stakeholder management.
* Experience with CRM\-based pipeline management and forecasting. Salesforce experience is preferred.
* Strong written and spoken English. Proficiency in Hindi and additional Indian languages is advantageous.

### **Core Competencies**


* Direct customer acquisition and strategic account development
* Technical sales and consultative value selling
* Business development and market creation
* Complex opportunity and tender management
* Negotiation, commercial judgment, and closing discipline
* Customer focus and long\-term relationship management
* Cross\-functional coordination and clear communication
* Decision\-making, accountability, and structured execution
* Market intelligence and competitive positioning
* Forecast accuracy and CRM discipline

### **Measures of Success**


* Achievement of approved new equipment and service order\-intake, revenue, and margin objectives.
* Growth and quality of the qualified direct\-customer pipeline.
* Conversion of strategic opportunities and acquisition of new MWM customers in India.
* Early specification and positioning of MWM in priority projects.
* Development of sustainable relationships with end users, EPCs and consultants.
* Forecast accuracy, opportunity data quality and timely execution of agreed next steps.
* Customer satisfaction and effective coordination from opportunity development through handover.

### **Positioning Statement for Candidates**



This role offers the opportunity to shape MWM’s direct market presence in India. It is suited to a commercially ambitious power\-generation professional who wants to build strategic customer relationships, influence complex energy projects and take visible ownership of growth in one of MWM’s priority markets.

This job description is intended as a general guide to the role. It is not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, or effort required. The company may revise the description to address evolving business and organizational needs. Final title, grade, reporting line, targets, and employment conditions remain subject to approval by management and Human Resources.



Additional information: This job requires 5days in a week working from office.

September 9, 2026 \- September 23, 2026 Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

Our fully managed pipelines let data teams move data from 150\+ sources (databases, SaaS applications, cloud storage, SDKs, streaming services) into warehouses and lakes, all without writing code.
 



  





 Over 2,000 data teams in 45\+ countries use Hevo, including DoorDash, Foot Locker, Iceland Air and Shopify. We’re top\-rated in the G2 Data Pipeline category, backed by Sequoia Capital, Qualgro, and Chiratae Ventures, and operate out of San Francisco and Bangalore.
 



  





**Why This Role Matters** 




 Hevo’s customers are data engineers, analytics leaders, and platform teams who rely on us for critical data infrastructure. Customer Success here goes well beyond satisfaction surveys. The job is to help technical teams get real value from their pipelines, cut the time it takes to get to insight, and grow their data operations.
 



 We’re looking for a strong leader to build and run the CS function. You’ll own the full post\-sales journey (onboarding, adoption, renewal, expansion) and be directly accountable for Net Revenue Retention and customer health across our global base.
 



  





**The Setup** 



* A growing team of TAMs, based primarily in Bangalore and Pune
* A product with 1000\+ customers but an evolving post\-sales playbook for 250\-300 accounts
* A customer base spanning SMB to enterprise across e\-commerce, fintech, medtech and B2B Software companies.
* Strong executive support and buy\-in for investing in Technical Account Management
* A chance to shape CS strategy at a company that’s defining the data pipeline category



  





**Responsibilities** 




**Build and Own the TAM Program** 



* Design and roll out Hevo\-specific TAM playbooks covering onboarding, adoption, health scoring, renewal, and expansion
* Segment the customer base (enterprise, mid\-market, self\-serve) and build the right engagement model for each
* Own net revenue retention, gross retention, and expansion metrics



**Drive Customer Outcomes** 



* Improve renewal rates and reduce churn by driving deeper product adoption and making sure customers see tangible results
* Work with Sales on cross\-sell and upsell opportunities, always leading with retention
* Build customer advocacy through NPS programs, case studies, and community engagement
* Grow lifetime value by catching risks early through health monitoring and having clear playbooks for when to step in



**Customer Lifecycle** 



* Map out the customer journey for Hevo’s technical buyers and end users
* Set up the right checkpoints across the lifecycle (usage data, satisfaction signals, support sentiment) and create standard responses for each stage
* Keep improving based on what the data and customer feedback tell you



**Lead and Grow the Team** 



* Hire and develop strong TAMs
* Put together an onboarding process that gets new hires productive fast
* Build a team culture where people are technically curious, care about customers, and take ownership of outcomes



**Measure What Matters** 



* Define and track operational metrics: time\-to\-value, adoption rates, health scores, NRR, GRR.
* Build dashboards and regular review cadences, and report key metrics to the executive team and board



**Cross\-Functional Work** 



* Work with Product to make sure customer insights feed into the roadmap
* Coordinate with Sales on ideal customer definition, handoff process, and expansion pipeline
* Team up with Marketing on customer campaigns, advocacy programs, and lifecycle comms
* Work with Finance on forecasting, renewal projections, and unit economics



**Invest in CS/TAM Technology** 



* Use AI and automation to make the program more efficient and scale the team’s impact without growing headcount at the same rate



  





**Who We’re Looking For** 




**Must\-Have** 



* 10\+ years of overall experience, and 5\+ years leading Technical Customer Success or Tech Account Mgmt teams in B2B SaaS, with experience building or scaling a technical CS/TAM function
* Experience with technical or developer\-facing products, ideally in data infrastructure, analytics, or related areas like ETL/ELT, data warehousing, observability, or DevOps
* Track record of owning and improving net revenue retention in a subscription / recurring\-revenue business
* Comfortable managing technical CSEs who spend their days working with data engineers and analysts
* Analytical and numbers\-driven. You make decisions based on data and you build the systems to track it
* Strong communication skills. Comfortable presenting to the board and working across functions to get things done



  





**Nice\-to\-Have** 



* Time spent at a modern data stack company (Fivetran, dbt, Snowflake, Databricks, Airbyte, or similar)
* Familiarity with usage\-based or consumption\-based pricing models
* Mix of technical (engineering, solutions) and business (CS, account management) experience
* Experience managing CSEs across multiple geographies or time zones



  





**Why Hevo** 



* We’re in a large, growing market (data integration is projected to hit $17B\+) and we’re one of the leaders
* Our customers actually like the product. Top\-rated on G2, with strong word\-of\-mouth growth
* Sequoia Capital\-backed with strong investor support
* CS is treated as a growth function here, not a cost center. You’ll have real ownership
* Low\-ego team with deep engineering and product roots

title: ITSM - Knowledge Management - Associate/Senior Associate
description:
### **Description**

  

The Knowledge Manager owns the operational governance and full lifecycle of IT knowledge used by the Service Desk, resolver teams and end users. Reporting to the Senior Lead Associate \- Service Desk and Knowledge Management, the role converts technical and operational expertise into accurate, searchable, reusable and user\-friendly content.  

The role works across Incident, Request, Problem and Change Management to embed knowledge capture and reuse into day\-to\-day practices, strengthen first\-contact resolution and improve self\-service. This is an individual\-contributor role; Service Desk leadership, staffing, escalation ownership and strategic direction remain with the Senior Lead Associate.### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* Execute and continually improve the Knowledge Management roadmap under the direction of the Senior Lead Associate.
* Maintain KM policies, standards, article templates, ownership models, approval workflows and review schedules.
* Govern the complete article lifecycle, including creation, validation, publication, review, update, archive and retirement.
* Maintain taxonomy, metadata, naming and tagging standards to improve findability and consistency.
* Coordinate knowledge health reviews and remediate stale, duplicate, inaccurate or low\-value content.
* Embed knowledge capture, reuse and improvement into Incident, Request, Problem and Change workflows.
* Facilitate knowledge harvesting after major incidents, recurring incidents, problem investigations, releases and significant changes.
* Work with Service Desk analysts, subject matter experts, resolver groups and service owners to capture and validate solutions.
* Ensure known errors, workarounds and standard resolutions are converted into governed knowledge where appropriate.
* Support operational readiness by ensuring new or changed services have approved support knowledge before go\-live.
* Apply Knowledge\-Centred Service principles and coach authors, reviewers and approvers on contribution behaviours and quality standards.
* Curate clear, task\-based content for self\-service and approved support channels.
* Use search results, user feedback and ticket trends to identify content gaps and improvement priorities.
* Administer and improve ServiceNow KM workflows, including templates, approvals, feedback and lifecycle controls.
* Identify automation opportunities for classification, tagging, review reminders, duplicate detection and content recommendations.
* Support controlled use of AI\-assisted knowledge capabilities with human review and governance.
* Maintain measures for article quality, freshness, reuse, findability, contribution and self\-service success.
* Produce regular KM reporting and maintain a prioritised improvement backlog for the Senior Lead Associate.

  

### **Skills, Knowledge \& Expertise**

  

* Mandatory total professional experience: 7 to 12 years.
* Mandatory relevant experience: 4 to 7 years in Knowledge Management, KCS, ITSM knowledge governance, technical content governance or a related discipline.
* Practical experience in an IT Service Desk, technical support or IT operations environment.
* Hands\-on experience managing knowledge in ServiceNow Knowledge Management or a comparable enterprise ITSM platform.
* Experience improving KM governance, workflows, taxonomies, article standards and review controls.
* Experience integrating knowledge activities with Incident, Request, Problem and Change Management.
* Experience using reports and analytics to identify knowledge gaps and drive continual improvement.
* Experience facilitating knowledge\-harvesting sessions and coaching contributors.
* Minimum education: Bachelor's degree in information technology, Computer Science, Business, Communications or a related discipline.
* Desirable: experience with KCS maturity, self\-service portals, enterprise search, chatbots, virtual agents, ServiceNow AI capabilities or global shared services.

**Knowledge, Skill, ability*** Strong understanding of ITIL 4 Knowledge Management and its relationship with Service Desk and core ITSM practices.
* Practical knowledge of KCS principles, knowledge lifecycle governance and content quality controls.
* Hands\-on understanding of ServiceNow Knowledge Management, article structures, workflows and reporting.
* Ability to design and maintain taxonomies, metadata, tagging structures and content templates.
* Ability to translate complex technical information into concise and audience\-appropriate content.
* Strong analytical skills across search, usage, quality, feedback and operational data.
* Strong facilitation, coaching and stakeholder\-influencing skills without direct reporting authority.
* Sound understanding of accessibility, version control, auditability and responsible AI governance.

  

**Essential requirement (non\-negotiable) \**** Total professional experience within the 7 to 12\-year range.
* Minimum 4 years of directly relevant Knowledge Management, KCS or ITSM knowledge\-governance experience.
* Hands\-on ServiceNow Knowledge Management or comparable enterprise ITSM knowledge\-platform experience.
* Practical experience in a Service Desk, technical support or IT operations environment.
* ITIL 4 Foundation certification.
* Strong written communication and ability to simplify technical information.
* Ability to work the stated UK shift from Pune.

We are a specialist professional services and technology firm, working in partnership with leading insurance, highly regulated and global businesses.  

  

We help our clients to manage risk, operate their core business processes, transform and grow. Our global team of more than 8,000 professionals operate across ten countries, including the UK \& the U.S. Over the past ten years Davies has grown its annual revenues more than 20\-fold, investing heavily in research \& development, innovation \& automation, colleague development, and client service. Today the group serves more than 1,500 insurance, financial services, public sector, and other highly regulated clients.

title: Data Platform Consultant (DBT)
description:
### **Description**

  

**The headlines...**  

  

**Immediate Joiners Preferred**  

**Location** \- Hybrid in our central Pune office  

  

**A few application tips…**  

  

We want to help you put your best foot forward. Here are a few things we look for:* Clear, specific examples of your work and impact
* Relevant experience aligned with the role’s focus
* A thoughtful response to any application questions
* A resume that highlights both what you did and why it mattered

If you’re unsure whether your background is the “perfect fit,” we still encourage you to apply. We value potential and growth just as much as experience.  

  

**Why this role exists…**  

This role is designed to strengthen our delivery capability across our most strategic accounts in industries like Consumer Goods, Financial Services and Energy.  

As the demand for data and AI\-driven transformation grows, so does the need for structured, proactive project leadership. At Snap Analytics, we help clients unlock the full potential of their data, and we’re scaling fast**.**  

  

We’re building DBT capability on a project. As a small, agile organisation, we’re investing in people who can help us deliver quickly and grow our competency in India with support from UK colleagues. You’ll have clear impact from day one and room to move across projects as you develop.### **What you’ll be doing…**

  

You’ll play a central role in designing and delivering data transformations that power a high‑visibility project. You’ll work closely with project leads, project managers, and senior engineers to ship quality outcomes with increasing autonomy.  

  

**Your responsibilities will include:**
* **Data Modelling:** Design, develop, and maintain complex data models using dbt Core to support various business functions.
* **Pipeline Optimization:** Build and manage scalable data transformation pipelines within Snowflake, ensuring high performance and cost\-efficiency.
* **Code Quality:** Implement software engineering best practices in the data stack, including version control (Git), modularity, and CI/CD.
* **Testing \& Documentation:** Ensure data integrity by writing robust dbt tests and maintaining comprehensive documentation via dbt docs.
* **Performance Tuning:** Optimize Snowflake compute and storage by managing clustering keys, materialized views, and efficient SQL querying.
* **Stakeholder Collaboration:** Work closely with Data Analysts and Business Leads to translate business requirements into technical data schemas.

**In your first 3–6 months, success might look like:*** Delivering the majority of your assigned work independently, to a high standard (quality \+ on‑time)
* Demonstrating holistic project understanding \- how your work fits the wider data flow and business goals
* Building healthy working relationships across the India team and, over time, with UK stakeholders

  

### **What you’ll need to succeed…**

  

We’re looking for someone who brings a mix of experience, curiosity, and collaboration.  

  

**You might be a great fit if you have:**
* **2 years’ experience** in dbt Core, including macros, packages (like dbt\-utils), and Jinja templating (we’re not considering freshers for this role)
* Strong **SQL** fundamentals and practical exposure to **DBT**
* Deep understanding of Snowflake\-specific features such as Tasks, Streams, Snowpipe, and Zero\-copy cloning.
* Familiarity with **Git/Bitbucket** and awareness of **CI/CD** concepts (nice to have)
* **Clear communication \-** you can articulate your thinking to technical and non‑technical partners
* **A** **learning mindset**: proactive, curious, and willing to work “a notch above” expectations (automation, generalising code, improving process)
* **Transparency** and ownership \- comfortable asking for help early and taking accountability for outcomes

**This role might not be the right fit if you’re looking for:*** Highly siloed work with very narrow task scopes (we value holistic project thinking)
* Constant step‑by‑step guidance (we expect growing autonomy and initiative)

  

### **Why choose Snap**

  

* **Impact from day one** on a new, high‑visibility project
* **Growth in a small, agile company** with opportunities to rotate across projects as you develop
* **Supportive team culture \-** mentorship from seniors, collaboration with India \& UK colleagues, open feedback and help‑seeking encouraged

### **About Snap Analytics**


We're a high\-growth data analytics consultancy on a mission to help enterprise businesses unlock the full potential of their data. With offices in the UK, India, and South Africa, we specialise in cutting\-edge cloud analytics solutions, transforming complex data challenges into actionable business insights.  

  

We partner with some of the biggest brands worldwide to modernise their data platforms, enabling smarter decision\-making through Snowflake, Databricks, Matillion, and other cloud technologies. Our approach is customer\-first, innovation\-driven, and results\-focused, delivering impactful solutions with speed and precision.  

  

At Snap, we’re not just consultants, we’re problem\-solvers, engineers, and strategists who thrive on tackling complex data challenges. Our culture is built on collaboration, continuous learning, and pushing boundaries, ensuring our people grow just as fast as our business.  

  

Join us and be part of a team that’s shaping the future of data analytics!

description:
Pune \| Veröffentlicht am 08\.09\.2026* 
At PALFINGER, we have been lifting goods to a new level for over 90 years \- with a pioneering and passionate spirit. As a global technology and engineering company, we are the world's leading manufacturer and supplier of innovative crane and lifting solutions. Our success is based on the tireless efforts of our approximately 12,350 employees, who contribute their ideas and energy to our vision. With us, you can expect a dynamic working environment full of opportunities for personal and professional development. Become part of our team and start your career at PALFINGER.


The overall purpose of this job is to ensure the proper maintenance and functioning of production equipment within PALFINGER AG. This includes scheduled and preventative maintenance, repairs, calibrations, and upgrades to support the smooth operation of production processes and contribute to the overall efficiency of the company's operations.


**Your Responsibilities**
-------------------------


* Develop and manage strategic relationships with government organizations, defence establishments, PSUs, and institutional customers.
* Identify and pursue opportunities in government tenders, military programs, and public procurement platforms (GeM, defence procurement, etc.)
* Lead the end\-to\-end tender management process, including opportunity identification, technical and commercial proposal preparation, compliance review, and submission.
* Achieve defined sales targets, revenue growth, and market penetration for PALFINGER products and solutions.
* Build and execute account strategies for key government and strategic accounts.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders including engineering, product management, service, and supply chain to deliver customer\-specific solutions.
* Conduct customer meetings, technical presentations, and product demonstrations for government agencies and defence organizations.
* Monitor competitor activity, policy changes, and government procurement trends to identify potential opportunities.
* Maintain strong relationships with system integrators, OEM partners, and contractors involved in government projects.
* Manage contract negotiations, compliance requirements, and documentation related to government procurement processes.
* Ensure accurate sales pipeline management, forecasting, and reporting through CRM systems.
* Represent PALFINGER in industry events, defence exhibitions, and government procurement forums.
**Your Qualifications**
-----------------------


* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Business Administration, or related field.
* 7–12 years of B2B sales experience, preferably in capital equipment, construction equipment, defence equipment, or industrial machinery.

description:
**Who we are**
--------------



VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology \& Transformation.
  

As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next\-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry\-first model which brings together the best of in\-house and 3rd party capability.
  

We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  

\#VOIS \#BeUnrivalled \#CreateTheFuture

**About this Role**
-------------------



We are seeking a Customer Success professional who will manage long\-term relationships with international enterprise customers, ensuring retention, satisfaction, and service adoption. This role focuses on delivering an exceptional customer experience by overseeing service performance, driving improvements, resolving escalations, and guiding customers across connectivity, cloud, cybersecurity, IoT, SD\-WAN and other telecom services. The individual will be responsible for customer engagement across multiple global regions, support contract commitments, and contribute to financial performance through commercial awareness and service optimisation.

**What you’ll do**
------------------


* Drive customer satisfaction, retention and experience, ensuring high Net Promoter Scores (NPS).
* Manage end\-to\-end relationships with global enterprise customers across multiple regions and segments including multinational corporations and public sector organisations.
* Act as the primary point of contact for all service\-related discussions with senior customer decision\-makers.
* Oversee contract management, ensuring operational and enabling teams meet all obligations.
* Analyse service performance, identify gaps, and drive continuous service improvements.
* Lead monthly and quarterly customer service reviews, maintaining documentation and follow\-up actions.
* Manage service lifecycle across sell–build–run phases.Guide various service and delivery teams in resolving escalations outside business\-as\-usual processes.
* Maintain accurate customer and service inventories, updating reports and dashboards as required.
* Identify opportunities for cross\-selling, upselling, and plugging revenue leakages.
* Support delivery teams in clearing on\-hold orders and coordinating with cross‑functional teams.
* Champion digitalisation by identifying areas where manual reporting can be automated.
* Mentor and provide guidance to service management analysts.
**Who you are**
---------------


* Experienced in customer‑facing international Customer Success roles (4\+ years).
* Skilled in telecom products such as Fixed Line, Mobility, Cybersecurity, SD\-WAN, IoT, SaaS, MPN, Cloud and Unified Communications.
* ITIL 4 certified with strong understanding of service lifecycle management.
* An effective communicator able to engage confidently with senior customer stakeholders.
* Technically sound in networking fundamentals (SDH, DWDM, MPLS, LAN/WAN, Internet, Fixed Voice, SD\-WAN).
